a: Kuttach habbavli vechol mine kuttach asur limkor sheloshim yom kodem happesach.
Tanu rabbanan: notnin mezonot lifne hakkelev bechatzer. netalo veyatza — en nizkakin lo.
Kayyotze bo: notnin mezonot lifne haggoy bechatzer. netalo veyatza — en nizkakin lo. ha tu lema li, hayeynu hach. mahu detema: hay reme aleh, vehay la reme aleh — ka mashma lan.

Tanu rabbanan: lo yaskir adam kelav legoy beerev shabbat, birvii uvachamishi muttar. kayyotze bo, en meshallechin iggerot beyad goy beerev shabbat, birvii uvachamishi — muttar. amru alav al rabbi yose hakkohen, veamri la al rabbi yose hechasid, shello nimtza ketav yado beyad goy meolam.
Tanu rabbanan: en meshallechin iggeret beyad goy erev shabbat, ella im ken kotzetz lo damim. bet shammay omrim: kede sheyyaggia leveto, uvet hillel omrim: kede sheyyaggia labbayit hassamuch lachoma.
Vahalo katzatz? amar rav sheshet, hachi kaamar: veim lo katzatz — bet shammay omrim: ad sheyyaggia leveto, uvet hillel omrim: ad sheyyaggia labbayit hassamuch lachoma.
Vehaamrat resha en meshallechin? la kashya: ha dikvia be davvar bemata, veha dela kevia be davvar bemata.

Tanu rabbanan: en mafligin bisfina pachot mishshelosha yamim kodem lashshabbat. bamme devarim amurim — lidvar harshut, aval lidvar mitzva — shappir dame. ufosek immo al menat lishbot, veeno shovet — divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: eno tzarich. umitztzor letzidon — afillu beerev shabbat muttar.
Tanu rabbanan: en tzarin al ayayrot shel goyim pachot mishshelosha yamim kodem lashshabbat. veim hitchilu — en mafsikin. vechen haya shammay omer: "ad ridtah", afillu beshabbat.

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: nohagin hayu vechulei. tanya amar rabbi tzadok: kach haya minhago shel bet rabban gamliel, shehayu notnin kele lavan lechoves shelosha yamim kodem lashshabbat, utzevuim afillu beerev shabbat. umiddivrehem lamadnu shehallevanim kashim lechabbesan yoter min hatztzevuin.

Abbaye hava yahev leh hahu mana ditzvia lekatztzara. amar leh: kamma baet illaveh. amar leh: kidchivvara. amar leh: kevar kadmucha rabbanan. amar abbaye: hay man deyahev mana lekatztzara, bemishcha nittev leh uvemishcha nishkol minneh. dei tefe — afsedeh dematcheh. vei betzir — afsedeh dechavvevtzeh.

Veshavin ellu veellu, shettoanin kulei: may shena kullehu digzaru behu bet shammay, umay shena korot bet habbad veiggule haggat dela gezaru? hanach dei aved lehu beshabbat michayyayv chattat — gezaru behu bet shammay erev shabbat im chashecha. korot bet habbad veiggule haggat dei aved lehu beshabbat la michayyayv chattat — la gezaru.

Man tanna dechol midde deate mimmela, shappir dame? amar rabbi yose (bar) [berabbi] chanina: rabbi yishmael hi, ditnan: hashshum vehabboser vehammelilot sherissekan mibbeod yom, rabbi yishmael omer: yigmor mishshettechshach, verabbi akiva omer:
b: Lo yigmor. verabbi elazar amar: rabbi elazar hi. ditnan: challot devash sherissekan beerev shabbat veyatzu meatzman — asur, verabbi elazar mattir.

Verabbi yose bar chanina may tama la amar kerabbi elazar? amar lach, hatam hu demeikkara ochel ulevassof ochel, hacha meikkara ochel vehasheta mashke. verabbi elazar amar lach: ha shaminan leh lerabbi elazar daafillu zetim vaanavim name share. deha ki ata rav hoshaya minnehardea, ata veayyti matnita bideh: zetim vaanavim sherissekan meerev shabbat veyatzu meatzman — asurin. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon mattirin. verabbi yose bar chanina barayyta la shemia leh.

Verabbi elazar may tama la amar kerabbi yose bar chanina? amar lach: lav ittemar ala amar rava bar chanina amar rabbi yochanan: bimchussarin dicha — dechulle alma la peligi, ki peligi bimchussarin shechika. vehane name kimchussarin dicha damu. hora rabbi yose bar chanina kerabbi yishmael.

Shemen shel baddadin umachtzalot shel baddadin — rav asar ushemuel share. hane kerache dezuze — rav asar ushemuel share. amar rav nachman: ez lachalavah, verachel legizzatah, vetarnegolet levetzatah, vetore deridya, vetamre deiska — rav asar, ushemuel amar: muttar. vekamippalgi biflugeta derabbi yehuda verabbi shimon.

Hahu talmida deori becharta deargez kerabbi shimon, shamteh rav hamenuna. veha kerabbi shimon sevira lan? beatreh derav hava la ibbeay leh lemibad hachi. hane tere talmide, chad matztzil bechad mana, vechad matztzil bearba vachamesh mane — vekamippalgi biflugeta derabba bar zavda verav huna.

Mishna en tzolin basar batzal uvetza ella kede sheyyitztzolu mibbeod yom. en notnin pat lattannur im chashecha, velo charara al gabbe gechalim, ella kede sheyyikremu paneha mibbeod yom. rabbi eliezer omer: kede sheyyikrom hattachton shellah. meshalshelin et happesach battannur im chashecha. umaachizin et haur bimdurat bet hammoked.

a: Uvaggevulin, kede shetteechoz haur berubbo. rabbi yehuda omer: befechamin — kol shehu.

Gemara vechamma? amar rabbi elazar amar rav: kede sheyyitztzolu mibbeod yom kemaachol ben derosay. ittemar name, amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: kol shehu kemaachol ben derosay, en bo mishshum bishshule goyim. tanya chananya omer: kol shehu kemaachol ben derosay — muttar lehashehoto al gabbe kira veaf al pi sheen gerufa uketuma.
En notnin et happat kulei: ibbaya lehu, tachton haych degabbe tannur, o dilma tachton haych degabbe haur? ta shema, rabbi eliezer omer: kede sheyyikremu paneha hamedubbakin battannur.
Meshalshelin et happesach: may tama? — mishshum divne chavura zerizin hen. ha lav hachi la?! vehaamar mar: gadya ben sherik ben la sherik — shappir dame! hatam minnetach, hacha la minnetach.

Umaachizin et haur vechulei: menahane mille amar rav huna: "lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem". bechol moshvotechem i atta mavir, aval atta mavir bimdurat bet hammoked. matkif la rav chisda: i hachi, afillu beshabbat name? ella amar rav chisda: kera ki ata lemishre evarim ufedarim hu daata, vechohanim zerizin hen.

Uvaggevulin kede shetteechoz kulei. may rubban? amar rav: rov kol echad veechad. ushemuel amar: kede shello yomru "have etzim venanniach tachtehen". tane rav chiyyay lesayyoeh lishmuel, kede shettehe shalhevet ola meeleha velo shettehe shalhevet ola al yede davar acher.

Etz yechidi, rav amar: rov ovyo, veamri la: berov hekkefo. amar rav pappa: hilkach baenan rov ovyo uvaenan rov hekkefo. ketannae: rabbi chiyyay amar: kede sheyyishshachet haetz mimmelechet haumman, rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: kede shettochaz haesh mishshene tzedadin. veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar: "et shene ketzotav achla haesh vetocho nachar hayitzlach limlacha".
"Vehaach lefanav mevoaret". may ach? amar rav: achvona. ushemuel amar: etzim shennidleku beachvona. hahu deamar lehu man bae achvona? ishtechach aravta.

Amar rav huna: kanim en tzerichin rov, agadan — tzerichin rov. garinin en tzerichin rov, netanan bechotalot — tzerichin rov. matkif la rav chisda: adderabba, ippecha mistabbera: kanim — mibbadderan, agadan — la mibbadderan. garinin — mibbadderan, netanan bechotalot — la mibbadderan. ittemar name
b: Amar rav kahana: kanim sheagadan — tzerichin rov, lo agadan — en tzerichin rov. garinin — tzerichin rov, netanan bechotalot — en tzerichin rov.
Tane rav yosef: arba medurot en tzerichin rov: shel zefet, veshel gofrit, veshel gevina, veshel revav. bematnita tana: af shel kash veshel gevava.

Amar rabbi yochanan: etzim shel bavel en tzerichin rov. matkif la rav yosef: may hi? ilema silte — hasheta petila amar ulla hammadlik tzarich sheyyadlik berov hayyotze, silte mibbaya? ella amar rav yosef: socha dearza. rame bar abba amar: zaza.
Haderan alach yetziot hashshabbat

Mishna bamme madlikin uvamma en madlikin? en madlikin lo belechesh, velo bechosen, velo bechalach, velo biftilat haidan, velo biftilat hammidbar, velo biroka sheal pene hammayim, velo bezefet, velo beshaava, velo beshemen kik, velo beshemen serefa, velo bealya, velo bechelev. nachum hammadi omer: madlikin bechelev mevushshal. vachachamim omrim: echad mevushshal veechad sheeno mevushshal en madlikin bo.
Gemara lechesh — socha dearza. socha dearza etz bealma hu! beamranita deit beh.
Velo bechosen. amar rav yosef: neoret shel pishtan. amar leh abbaye: vehachtiv "vehaya hechason linoret", mikkelal dechosen lav neoret hu! ella amar abbaye: kittana didyik vela nefitz.
Velo bechalach. amar shemuel: sheeltinhu lechol nachote yamma veamri (la) kulecha shemeh. rav yitzchak bar zeera amar: gushekra.
Ravin veabbaye havo yatvi kammeh derabbana nechemya achu deresh galuta. chazyeh dahava levish metachsa. amar leh ravin leabbaye: hayeynu kalach ditnan. amar leh: anan "shira peranda" karenan leh.
Metivi: hashshiraim vehakkalach vehasserikin chayyayvin betzitzit, teyuveta deravin! teyuveta. ibbaet ema: shira lechud, veshira peranda lechud.

Velo biftilat haidan — achvina. ravin veabbaye havo kaazli befakta detamrurita. chazanhi lehanhu arvata. amar leh ravin leabbaye: hayeynu idan ditnan. amar leh: hahi etz bealma hu! kelaf veachvi leh amranita devene bene. velo biftilat hammidbar — shavra.
Velo biroka sheal kulei. may hi? ilema ukkamta dacharitze — ipparoche mipparchan. ella amar rav pappa: ukkamta dearba.
Tana: hosifu alehen shel tzemer veshel sear. vetanna didan: tzemer michvotz kavevytz, sear icharoche micharach.
Velo bezefet. zefet — zifta, shaava — kiruta. tana: ad kan pesul petilot, mikkan veelach pesul shemanim. peshita! shaava itztericha leh. mahu detema liftilot name la chazya, ka mashma lan.
Amar rame bar avin: itrana — pesuleta dezifta. shaava — pesuleta deduvesha.

a: Lemay nafka minna? lemikkach umimkar.

Tanu rabbanan: kol ellu sheamru en madlikin bahen beshabbat, aval osin mehen medura — ben lehitchammem kenegdah ben lehishtammesh leorah, ben al gabbe karka, ben al gabbe kira. velo asru ella laasot mehen petila lanner bilvad.

Velo beshemen kik vechulei. may shemen kik? amar shemuel: sheeltinhu lechol nachote yamma, vaamaru li: of echad yesh bichrakke hayyam vekik shemo. rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda amar: mishcha dekaza. resh lakish amar: kikayon deyona. amar rabba bar bar chana: ledidi chazi li kikayon deyona, velitzluliva dame umiddufsheke rave, veal pum chanvata madlan yateh, umippartzidohi avdi mishcha, uveanfohi nayychan kol beriche demareva.
Amar rabba: petilot sheamru chachamim en madlikin bahen beshabbat, mippene shehaur mesachsechet bahen. shemanim sheamru chachamim en madlikin bahen, mippene sheen nimshachin achar happetila.

Bea minneh abbaye merabba: shemanim sheamru chachamim en madlikin bahen beshabbat, mahu sheyyitten letochan shemen kol shehu veyadlik? mi gazrinan dilma ate leadloke beenayyhu, o la? amar leh: en madlikin. may tama? lefi sheen madlikin.

Etiveh: karach davar shemmadlikin bo al gabbe davar sheen madlikin bo — en madlikin bo. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: shel bet abba hayu korchin petila al gabbe egoz umadlikin. katane mihat madlikin!

Amar leh: addemotvat leh midderabban shimon ben gamliel, sayyeyeh middetanna kamma! ha la kashya: "maase rav". mikkol makom kashya: may lav, lehadelik? la, lehakepot. i lehakepot, may tama detanna kamma? kullah rabban shimon ben gamliel hi vechassore michassera, vehachi katane: karach davar shemmadlikin bo al gabbe davar sheen madlikin bo — en madlikin bo. bamme devarim amurim — lehadelik, aval lehakepot — muttar, sherabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shel bet abba hayu korchin petila al gabbe egoz.

Ini?! vehaamar rav berona amar rav: chelev mehuttach vekirve dagim shennimmochu, adam noten letochan shemen kol shehu umadlik? hane mimmashchi beenayyhu, vehane la mimmashchi beenayyhu. ugezaru rabbanan al chelev mehuttach mishshum chelev sheeno mehuttach, veal kirve dagim shennimmochu mishshum kirve dagim shello nimmochu. veligzor name chelev mehuttach vekirve dagim shennimmochu shennatan letochan shemen mishshum chelev mehuttach vekirve dagim shennimmochu shello natan letochan shemen! hi gufah, gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera?!

Tane rame bar chama: petilot ushemanim sheamru chachamim en madlikin bahen beshabbat — en madlikin bahen bammikdash, mishshum shenneemar: "lehaalot ner tamid". hu tane la, vehu amar la — kede shettehe shalhevet ola meeleha, velo shettehe ola al yede davar acher.
Tenan: mibbelae michnese kohanim umehemyanehem hayu mafkiin, umehen madlikin. simchat bet hashshoeva shane.
Ta shema, detane rabba bar matna: bigde chehunna shebbalu mafkiin otan, umehen hayu osin petilot lammikdash. may lav, dechilayim? la, devutz.

Amar rav huna: petilot ushemanim sheamru chachamim en madlikin bahen beshabbat, en madlikin bahen bachanukka, ben beshabbat ben bachol. amar rava: may tama derav huna? — kasavar: kavta zakuk lah, umuttar lehishtammesh leorah. verav chisda amar: madlikin bahen bachol, aval lo beshabbat. kasavar: kavta
b: En zakuk lah, umuttar lehishtammesh leorah. amar rabbi zera amar rav matna, veamri la amar rabbi zera amar rav: petilot ushemanim sheamru chachamim en madlikin bahen beshabbat, madlikin bahen bachanukka, ben bachol ben beshabbat. amar rabbi yirmeya: may tama derav? — kasavar: kavta en zakuk lah, veasur lehishtammesh leorah.

Amruha rabbanan kammeh deabbaye mishshemeh derabbi yirmeya, vela kabbela. ki ata ravin amruha rabbanan kammeh deabbaye mishshemeh derabbi yochanan, vekabbela. amar: i zechay, gemirtay lishmateh meikkara. veha gamra! nafka minna legirsa deyankuta.
Vechavta en zakuk lah? ureminhu: mitzvatah mishshettishka hachamma ad shettichle regel min hashshuk. may lav, dei kavta hadar madlek lah! la, dei la adlek — madlek. vei name leshiura.
Ad shettichle regel min hashshuk. vead kamma? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: ad dechalya rigla detarmodae.

Tanu rabbanan: mitzvat chanukka, ner ish uveto. vehamehadderin, ner lechol echad veechad. vehamehadderin min hamehadderin, bet shammay omrim: yom rishon madlik shemona, mikkan veelach pochet veholech. uvet hillel omrim: yom rishon madlik achat, mikkan veelach mosif veholech.

Amar ulla: peligi ba tere amorae bemareva, rabbi yose bar avin verabbi yose bar zevida. chad amar tama devet shammay keneged yamim hannichnasin, vetama devet hillel keneged yamim hayyotzin. vechad amar tama devet shammay keneged pare hachag, vetama devet hillel demaalin bakkodesh veen moridin.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: shene zekenim hayu betzaydan. echad asa kevet shammay veechad asa kedivre bet hillel. ze noten taam lidvarav keneged pare hachag, veze noten taam lidvarav demaalin bakkodesh veen moridin.
Tanu rabbanan: ner chanukka mitzva lehannichah al petach beto mibbachutz. im haya dar baaliyyay — mannichah bachallon hassemucha lirshut harabbim. uvishat hassakkana — mannichah al shulchano vedayyo.
Amar rava: tzarich ner acheret lehishtammesh leorah. vei ikka medura — lo tzarich. vei adam chashuv hu — af al gav deikka medura tzarich ner acheret.

May chanukka? detanu rabbanan: bech bechislev yome dachanukka temanya innun dela lemispad behon udela lehitannot behon. shekkeshennichnesu yevavnim lahechol timmeu kol hashshemanim shebbahechol. uchesheggavra malchut bet chashmonay venitztzechum, badku velo matzu ella pach echad shel shemen shehaya munnach bechotamo shel kohen gadol, velo haya bo ella lehadelik yom echad. naasa bo nes vehidliku mimmennu shemona yamim. leshana acheret kevaum vaasaum yamim tovim behallel vehodaa.

Tenan hatam: getz hayyotze mittachat happattish veyatza vehizzik — chayyayv. gamal shettaun pishtan vehu over birshut harabbim venichnesa pishtano letoch hachanut vedalka benero shel chenvani vehidlik et habbira — baal haggamal chayyayv. hinniach chenvani et nero mibbechutz — chenvani chayyayv.

Rabbi yehuda omer: bener chanukka — patur. amar ravina mishshum derabba: zot omeret ner chanukka mitzva lehannichah betoch asara. dei salka datach lemala measara, lema leh: haya lach lehanniach lemala miggamal verochvo! vedilma, i mayttercha leh tuva ate leimmenoe mimmitzva.
Amar rav kahana, daresh rav natan bar minyome mishshemeh derabbi tanchum:

a: Ner shel chanukka shehinnicha lemala meesrim amma — pesula, kesukka uchemavoy. veamar rav kahana, daresh rav natan bar minyome mishshemeh derav tanchum: may dichtiv "vehabbor rek en bo mayim"? mimmashma shenneemar "vehabbor rek" eni yodea sheen bo mayim? ella ma talmud lomar "en bo mayim" — mayim en bo, aval nechashim veakrabbim yesh bo.

Amar rabba: ner chanukka mitzva lehannichah betefach hassamuch lappetach. vehecha mannach leh? rav acha bereh derava amar: miyyamin rav shemuel middifti amar: missemol. vehilcheta missemol, kede shettehe ner chanukka missemol umezuza miyyamin.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav assi amar rav: asur leharetzot maot keneged ner chanukka. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: vechi ner kedushsha yesh bah? matkef la rav yosef: vechi dam kedushsha yesh bo? detanya "veshafach … vechissa" — bamme sheshshafach yechasse. shello yechassennu baregel, shello yehu mitzvot bezuyot alav. hacha name, shello yehu mitzvot bezuyot alav.

Beo minneh merabbi yehoshua ben levi: mahu lehistappek minnoye sukka kol shiva? amar leh: hare amru asur leharetzot maot keneged ner chanukka. amar rav yosef: mareh deavraham! tale tanya bidla tanya. sukka tanya, chanukka la tanya. detanya: sikkechah kehilchatah veitterah bikramim uvisdinin hametzuyyayrin, vetala bah egozim, afarsekin, shekedim verimmonim, ufarkile anavim vaatarot shel shibbolim, yenot, (shel) shemanim uselatot — asur lehistappek mehen ad motzae yom tov haacharon shel chag. veim hitna alehen — hakkol lefi tenao! — ella amar rav yosef: avuhon dechullehu dam.

Ittemar: rav amar en madlikin minner lener, ushemuel amar madlikin. rav amar en mattirin tzitzit mibbeged leveged, ushemuel amar mattirin mibbeged leveged. rav amar en halacha kerabbi shimon bigrira, ushemuel amar halacha kerabbi shimon bigrira.

Amar abbaye: kol mille demar aved kerav levar mehane telat deaved kishmuel: madlikin minner lener, umattirin mibbeged leveged, vahalacha kerabbi shimon bigrira. detanya, rabbi shimon omer: gorer adam mitta kisse vesafsal — uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot charitz.

Yatev hahu merabbanan kammeh derav adda bar ahava veyatev vekaamar: tama derav mishshum bizzuy mitzva. amar lehu: la tetzitu leh, tameh derav mishshum deka machchish mitzva. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deka madlek mishsheraga lishraga: man deamar mishshum bizzuy mitzva — mishsheraga lishraga madlek. man deamar mishshum achchoshe mitzva — mishsheraga lishraga name asur.
Metiv rav avya: sela shel
b: Maaser sheni en shoklin kenegdo dinare zahav, vaafillu lechallel alav maaser sheni acher. i amrat bishlama ki peligi rav ushemuel minner lener aval bekinsa asar shemuel — ha la tihve teyuveta. ella i amrat bekinsa name share — ha tihve teyuveta! amar rabba: gezera shemma lo yechavven mishkelotav veka mappek lehu lechullin.

Metiv rav sheshet: "michutz lefarochet haedut yaaroch", vechi leorah hu tzarich? vahalo kol arbaim shana shehalchu vene yisrael bammidbar la halchu ella leoro! ella edut hi levae olam shehashshechina shora beyisrael. may edut? amar rav: zo ner maaravi shennoten bah shemen kemiddat chavroteha, umimmenna haya madlik uvah haya mesayyem. veha hacha kevan dikvii nerot, la sagya dela mishkal veadloke. kashya ben leman deamar mishshum bizzuy mitzva, uven leman deamar mishshum achchoshe mitzva!
Targema rav pappa biftilot arukkot. sof sof, leman deamar mishshum achchoshe mitzva kashya! — kashya.
May have ala? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: chazenan, i hadelaka osa mitzva — madlikin minner lener. vei hannacha osa mitzva — en madlikin minner lener.
Deibbaya lehu: hadelaka osa mitzva, o hannacha osa mitzva?
Ta shema, deamar rava: haya tafus ner chanukka veomed — lo asa velo chelum. shema minna: hannacha osa mitzva! hatam, haroe omer letzorko hu denaket la.

Ta shema, deamar rava: hidlikah bifnim vehotziah — lo asa kelum. i amrat bishlama hadelaka osa mitzva — hadelaka bimkomo baenan, mishshum hachi lo asa kelum. ella i amrat hannacha osa mitzva, ammay lo asa velo chelum? hatam name: haroe hu omer letzorko hu deadleka.
Ta shema deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi:

a: Ashashit shehayta doleket veholechet kol hayyom kullo, lemotzae shabbat mechabbah umadlikah. i amrat bishlama hadelaka osa mitzva — shappir. ella i amrat hannacha osa mitzva, hay mechabbah umadlikah, mechabbah umagbihah umannichah umadlikah mibbee leh! veod: middeka mevarchinan "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehadelik ner shel chanukka" — shema minna hadelaka osa mitzva. shema minna.

Vehasheta deamrinan hadelaka osa mitzva, hidlikah cheresh shote vekatan lo asa velo chelum. ishsha vadday madlika, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nashim chayyayvot bener chanukka sheaf hen hayu beoto hannes.

Amar rav sheshet: achsenay chayyayv bener chanukka. amar rabbi zera: meresh ki havena be rav, mishtattafna bifrite bahade ushepiza. batar dinsevi itteta, amena: hasheta vadday la tzerichna, deka madleki alay bego betay.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hashshemanim kullan yafin lanner, veshemen zayit min hammuvechar. amar abbaye: meresh hava mehaddar mar ammishcha deshumeshme. amar: hay meshich nehoreh tefe. kevan dishma la leha derabbi yehoshua ben levi, mehaddar ammishcha dezeta. amar: hay tzelil nehoreh tefe.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hashshemanim yafin laddeyo, veshemen zayit min hammuvechar. ibbaya lehu: legabbel, o leashshen? ta shema, detane rav shemuel bar zutera: kol hashshemanim yafin laddeyo, veshemen zayit min hammuvechar — ben legabbel ben leashshen. rav shemuel bar zutera matne hachi: kol haashanim yafin laddeyo, veshemen zayit min hammuvechar. amar rav huna: kol hasserafin yafin laddeyo, useraf ketaf yafe mikkullam.

Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: hammadlik ner shel chanukka tzarich levarech. verav yirmeya amar: haroe ner shel chanukka tzarich levarech. amar rav yehuda: yom rishon, haroe mevarech shetayim, umadlik mevarech shalosh. mikkan veelach, madlik mevarech shetayim, veroe mevarech achat. may memaet? memaet zeman: venimot nes! — nes kol yome iteh.

May mevarech? — mevarech: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehadelik ner shel chanukka". vehechan tzivvanu? rav avya amar: millo tasur". rav nechemya amar: "sheal avicha veyaggedcha zekenecha veyomru lach".

Metiv rav amram: haddemay, mearvin bo umishtattefin bo umevarchin alav umezammenin alav umafrishin oto arom uven hashshemashot. vei amrat kol midderabbanan bae beracha, hacha ki kae arom hechi mevarech? veha baenan vehaya machanecha kadosh — velekka! amar abbaye: vadday dedivrehem bae beracha, safek dedivrehem la bae beracha.
Veha yom tov sheni disfek divrehem hu, uvae beracha? hatam ki hechi dela lizalzelu be. rava amar: rov amme haaretz measserin hen.

Amar rav huna: chatzer sheyyesh lah shene petachim tzericha shete nerot. (veamar) [amar] rava: la amaran ella mishte ruchot, aval meruach achat — la tzerich. may tama? illema mishshum chashada — chashada deman? illema chashada dealma — afillu beruach achat name live! i chashada divne mata — afillu mishte ruchot name la live. leolam mishshum chashada divne mata, vezimnin dechalfi behay vela chalfi behay, veamri: ki hechi divhay pitcha la adlik — behach pitcha name la adlik.

Umena temra dechayyshinan lachashad? — detanya amar rabbi shimon: bishvil arbaa devarim amra tora lehanniach pea besof sadehu: mippene gezel aniyyim, umippene bittul aniyyim, umippene hachashad, umishshum "bal techalle". mippene gezel aniyyim — shello yire baal habbayit shaa penuyay veyomar likrovo ani: "hare zo pea".
b: Umippene bittul aniyyim — shello yehu aniyyim yoshvin umeshammerin "achshav manniach baal habbayit pea". umippene chashad — shello yihyu ovrin veshavin omrim: tavo meera leadam shello hinniach pea besadehu. umishshum "bal techalle". attu kullehu lav mishshum "bal techalle" ninhu? amar rava: mippene harammain.

Amar rav yitzchak bar redifa amar rav huna: ner sheyyesh lah shene fiyyot — ola lishne bene adam. amar rava: mille keara shemen vehikkifah petilot. kafa aleha keli — ola lechamma bene adam. lo kafa aleha keli — asaah kemin medura, vaafillu leechad name enah ola.

Amar rava: peshita li, ner beto vener chanukka — ner beto adif, mishshum shelom beto. ner beto vekiddush hayyom — ner beto adif, mishshum shelom beto. bae rava: ner chanukka vekiddush hayyom mahu? kiddush hayyom adif — ditdir, o dilma ner chanukka adif — mishshum parsome nissa? batar devaya, hadar pashta: ner chanukka adif, mishshum parsome nissa.

Amar rav huna: haragil bener havyin leh banim talmide chachamim. hazzahir bimzuza — zoche ledira naa. hazzahir betzitzit — zoche letallit naa. hazzahir bekiddush hayyom — zoche umemalle garve yayin. rav huna hava regil dahava chalef vetane appitcha derabbi avin naggara. chaza dahava regil bishrage tuva, amar: tere gavre ravreve nafki mehacha. nafki minnayyhu rav idi bar avin verav chiyyay bar avin. rav chisda hava regil dahava chalef vetane appitcha deve nasha derav shezvi. chaza dahava regil bishrage tuva, amar: gavra rabba nafek mehacha. nefak minnayyhu rav shezvi.

Devethu derav yosef havat meachara umadleka. amar la rav yosef: tanena "lo yamish ammud heanan yomam veammud haesh layla" — melammed sheammud anan mashlim leammud haesh veammud haesh mashlim leammud heanan. sevara leakdome. amar la hahu sava: tanena, uvilvad shello yakdim veshello yeacher.

Amar rava: derachem rabbanan, havu leh benin rabbanan. demokir rabbanan, havu leh chatnavota rabbanan. dedachel merabbanan, hu gufeh have tzureba merabbanan. vei lav bar hache hu, mishtaman milleh ketzureba merabbanan.

Velo beshemen serefa vechulei: may shemen serefa? amar rabba: shemen shel teruma shennitmea. veammay karu le "shemen serefa"? — hoil velisrefa omed. uveshabbat may tama la? mittoch shemmitzva alav levaaro, gezera shemma yatte. amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, beyom tov lishtere! allema tenan: en madlikin beshemen serefa beyom tov? — gezera yom tov attu shabbat.

Rav chisda amar: leshemma yatte la chayyshinan, ella hacha beyom tov shechal lihyot erev shabbat askinan — lefi sheen sorfin kodashim beyom tov. veha middekatane sefa en madlikin beshemen serefa beyom tov, mikkelal deresha lav beyom tov askinan! amar rav chanina missura: "ma taam" kaamar: ma taam en madlikin beshemen serefa beyom tov — lefi sheen sorfin kodashim beyom tov.

a: Tanya kevoteh derav chisda. kol ellu sheamru en madlikin bahen beshabbat, madlikin bahen beyom tov, chutz mishshemen serefa — lefi sheen sorfin kodashim beyom tov.

Ibbaya lehu: mahu lehazekir shel chanukka bevirkat hammazon? kevan demidderabbanan hu — la madkerinan, o dilma mishshum parsome nissa — madkerinan?! amar rava amar rav sechora amar rav huna: eno mazkir. veim ba lehazekir — mazkir bahodaa. rav huna bar yehuda ikkela leve rava. sevar leadkore bevone yerushalayim". amar lehu rav sheshet: kitfilla. ma tefilla bahodaa — af birkat hammazon bahodaa.

Ibbaya lehu: mahu lehazekir rosh chodesh bevirkat hammazon? im timtze lomar bachanukka derabbanan la tzerich, rosh chodesh deorayyta — tzerich. o dilma kevan dela asir baasiyyayt melacha — la madkerinan. rav amar: mazkir, rabbi chanina amar: eno mazkir. amar rav zerika: nekot derav bidach, dekae rabbi oshaya kevoteh. detane rabbi oshaya: yamim sheyyesh bahen korban musaf, kegon rosh chodesh vechullo shel moed — arvit veshacharit umincha mitpallel shemone esre veomer meen hameora baavoda. veim lo amar — machazirin oto. veen bahen kedushsha al hakkos, veyesh bahen hazekara bevirkat hammazon. yamim sheen bahen korban musaf, kegon sheni vachamishi vesheni vetaaniyyot umaamadot.

Sheni vachamishi may avidtayyhu? ella sheni vachamishi vesheni shel taaniyyot umaamadot. arvit veshacharit umincha mitpallel shemone esre, veomer meen hameora beshomea tefilla", veim lo amar — en machazirin oto. veen bahen kedushsha al hakkos veen bahen hazekara bevirkat hammazon.

Ibbaya lehu: mahu lehazekir shel chanukka bemusafin? kevan delet beh musaf bedideh la madkerinan, o dilma yom hu shechayyayv bearba tefillot. rav huna verav yehuda deamri tarvayyhu: eno mazkir. rav nachman verabbi yochanan deamri tarvayyhu: mazkir.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ha derav huna verav yehuda derav hu. deamar rav giddel amar rav: rosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat — hammaftir bannavi beshabbat eno tzarich lehazekir shel rosh chodesh, sheilmale shabbat en navi berosh chodesh

Mi dame?! hatam navi bidrosh chodesh lekka kelal, hacha iteh bearvit veshacharit umincha. ella leha damya: deamar rav achadvuy amar rav matna amar rav: yom tov shechal lihyot beshabbat, hammaftir benavi bemincha beshabbat eno tzarich lehazekir shel yom tov, sheilmale shabbat en navi bemincha beyom tov.
b: Velet hilcheta kechol hane shematata, ella ki ha deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: yom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat — hammitpallel neila tzarich lehazekir shel shabbat. yom hu shennitchayyev bearba tefillot.

Kashya hilcheta ahilcheta. amrat hilcheta kerabbi yehoshua ben levi, vekayyma lan hilcheta kerava. deamar rava: yom tov shechal lihyot beshabbat, sheliach tzibbur hayyored lifne hatteva arvit eno tzarich lehazekir shel yom tov, sheilmale shabbat en sheliach tzibbur yored arvit beyom tov.
Hachi hasheta?! hatam bedin hu daafillu beshabbat name la tzerich, verabbanan hu detakkinu mishshum sakkana. aval hacha — yom hu shennitchayyev bearba tefillot.
Velo bealya kulei. chachamim hayeynu tanna kamma! ikka venayyhu derav berona amar rav. vela mesayyeymi.

Mishna en madlikin beshemen serefa beyom tov. rabbi yishmael omer en madlikin beitran mippene kevod hashshabbat. vachachamim mattirin bechol hashshemanim: beshemen shumeshmin, beshemen egozim, beshemen tzenonot, beshemen dagim, beshemen pakkuot, beitran uveneft. rabbi tarfon omer: en madlikin ella beshemen zayit bilvad.

Gemara may tama? lefi sheen sorfin kodashim beyom tov. menahane mille? amar chizkiyya, vechen tana deve chizkiyya, amar kera: "velo totiru mimmennu ad boker vehannotar mimmennu ad boker". sheen talmud lomar "ad boker"! ma talmud lomar "ad boker" — ba hakkatuv litten lo boker sheni lisrefato.
Abbaye amar, amar kera: "olat shabbat beshabbatto" — velo olat chol beshabbat, velo olat chol beyom tov.
Rava amar, amar kera: "hu levaddo yease lachem". "hu" — velo machshirin. "levaddo" — velo milla shello bizmannah, deatya bekal vachomer.
Rav ashe amar: ("shabbat") "shabbaton" —

a: Ase. vehave leh yom tov ase velo taase — veen ase doche et lo taase vaase.

Beyom tov hu daasir, ha bechol — shappir dame: may tama? amar rav: keshem shemmitzva lisrof hakkodashim shennitmeu, kach mitzva lisrof et hatteruma shennitmet. veamra tora: bishat biurah tehane mimmenna. hechan amra tora? midderav nachman, deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu, amar kera: "vaani hinne natatti lecha et mishmeret terumotay" — bishte terumot hakkatuv medabbar, achat teruma tehora veachat teruma temea. veamar rachamana: "lecha" — shellecha tehe, lehassikah tachat tavshilcha.

Veibbaet ema midderabbi avahu. deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: "velo viarti mimmennu betame" — mimmennu i atta mavir, aval atta mavir shemen shel teruma shennitmet. veema: mimmennu i atta mavir, aval atta mavir shemen shel kodesh shennitma!
Lav kal vachomer hu? ma maaser hakkal amra tora lo biarti mimmennu betame, kodesh chamur — lo kol shekken?
I hachi, teruma name lema kal vachomer hu! — ha ketiv "mimmennu".
Uma raita! — mistabbera kodesh la memaetna, shekken (siman) 230 150: piggul, notar, korban, meila vecharet, asur leonen.
Adderabba, teruma la memaetna, shekken 135 (siman): mita, chomesh,
b: Veen lah pidyon, vaasura lezarim. hanach nefishan.
Veibbaet ema: kodesh chamur shekken anush karet. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar, amar kera: "titten lo". "lo" — velo leuro. mikkelal devat uro hu.

Rabbi yishmael omer kulei: may tama? amar rava: mittoch sherecho ra gezera shemma yannichenna veyetze. amar leh abbaye: veyetze! amar leh: sheani omer hadelakat ner beshabbat chova. deamar rav nachman bar rav zavda, veamri la amar rav nachman bar rava amar rav: hadelakat ner beshabbat chova, rechitzat yadayim veraglayim bechammin arvit, reshut. vaani omer: mitzva.

May mitzva? deamar rav yehuda amar rav: kach haya minhago shel rabbi yehuda bar ilay, erev shabbat meviim lo areva melea chammin verochetz panav yadav veraglav umitattef, veyoshev bisdinin hametzuyyaytzin, vedome lemalach Adonai tzevaot. vehayu talmidav mechabbin mimmennu kanfe chesutan. amar lahen: banay, lo kach shaniti lachem: sadin betzitzit, bet shammay potrin uvet hillel mechayyeyvin — vahalacha kedivre bet hillel. veinhu savri, gezera mishshum kesut layla.

"Vattiznach mishshalom nafshi nashiti tova". may "vattiznach mishshalom nafshi" — amar rabbi avahu: zo hadelakat ner beshabbat. "nashiti tova" — amar rabbi yirmeya: zo bet hammerchatz. amar rabbi yochanan zo rechitzat yadayim veraglayim bechammin. rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar: zo mitta naa vechelim naim shealeha. rabbi abba amar: zo mitta mutztzaat veishsha mekushshetet letalmide chachamim.

Tanu rabbanan: ezehu ashir? — kol sheyyesh lo nachat ruach beoshro, divre rabbi meir. siman 209. rabbi tarfon omer: kol sheyyesh lo mea keramim umea sadot umea avadim sheovdin bahen. rabbi akiva omer: kol sheyyesh lo ishsha naa bemaasim. rabbi yose omer: kol sheyyesh lo bet hakkisse samuch leshulechano.
Tanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: en madlikin bitzri. may tama? — amar rabba: mittoch sherecho nodef gezera shemma yistappek mimmennu. amar leh abbaye:

a: Lema mar: mippene shehu af. chada veod kaamar: chada — mippene shehu af. veod — gezera shemma yistappek mimmennu.
Hahi chamata dahavat sanya la lechalleta, amara la: zil ikkashshayt bemishcha daafarsema. azala ikkashshayt. ki ata[10] amara la: zil itlay sheraga. azala atla sheraga. innefach ba nura vaachalta.

"Umiddallat haaretz hishir nevuzaradan rav tabbachim lechormim uleyogvim". "kormim" — tane rav yosef ellu melakkete afarsemon meen gedi vead ramta. "yogvim" — ellu tzayyayde chillazon missullamot shel tzur vead chefa.

Tanu rabbanan: en madlikin betevel tame bachol, veen tzarich lomar beshabbat. kayyotze vo: en madlikin beneft lavan bachol, veen tzarich lomar beshabbat. bishlama neft lavan — mippene shehu af, aval tevel tame may tama?

Amar kera: "vaani hinne natatti lecha et mishmeret terumotay", bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber: achat teruma tehora veachat teruma temea. ma teruma tehora en lecha bah ella mishsheat harama veelach, af teruma temea en lecha bah ella mishsheat harama veelach.

Gufa. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: en madlikin bitzri, vechen haya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: tzori eno ella seraf meatze hakketaf. rabbi yishmael omer: kol hayyotze min haetz en madlikin bo. rabbi yishmael ben beroka omer: en madlikin ella bayyotze min happeri. rabbi tarfon omer: en madlikin ella beshemen zayit bilvad.

Amad rabbi yochanan ben nuri al raglav veamar: ma yaasu anshe vavel sheen lahem ella shemen shumeshmin? uma yaasu anshe maday sheen lahem ella shemen egozim? uma yaasu anshe alekkesanderiyya sheen lahem ella shemen tzenonot? uma yaasu anshe kappotkiyya sheen lahem lo kach velo kach, ella neft? — ella en lecha ella ma sheamru chachamim en madlikin.

Umadlikin beshemen dagim uveitran. rabbi shimon shezuri omer: madlikin beshemen pakkuot uveneft. somchos omer: kol hayyotze min habbasar en madlikin bo, ella beshemen dagim. somchos hayeynu tanna kamma? ikka benayyhu derav berona amar rav, vela mesayyeymi.
Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kol hayyotze min haetz en bo mishshum shalosh al shalosh, umesakkechin bo — chutz mippishtan. amar abbaye:
b: Rabbi shimon ben elazar vetanna deve rabbi yishmael amru davar echad. rabbi shimon ben elazar — ha daamaran. tanna deve rabbi yishmael may hi? — detane deve rabbi yishmael: hoil veneemru "begadim" battora setam, ufarat lecha hakkatuv beechad mehen tzemer ufishtim. ma lehallan tzemer ufishtim, af kol tzemer ufishtim.
Rava amar: shelosha al shelosha bishar begadim ikka benayyhu. derabbi shimon ben elazar — it leh. letanna deve rabbi yishmael — let leh.

Dechulle alma mihat shalosh al shalosh betzemer ufishtim mittamme bingaim. menalan? detanya: "beged" en li ella beged, shalosh al shalosh minnayin? — talmud lomar: "vehabbeged". veema lerabbot shelosha al shelosha? lav kal vachomer hu? hasheta sheti vaerev mittamme, shelosha al shelosha mibbaya?!

I hachi, shalosh al shalosh name lete bekal vachomer! ella: shelosha al shelosha, dachazu ben laashirim ben laaniyyim — ate bekal vachomer. shalosh al shalosh, laaniyyim hu dechazyayn laashirim la chazyayn — la ate bekal vachomer. tama dechatveh kera, ha la katveh kera — la gamrinan bekal vachomer.

Veema lerabbot shelosha al shelosha bishar begadim? amar kera: "beged tzemer ufishtim". beged tzemer ufishtim — in, midde acharine — la. veema ki immaut mishshalosh al shalosh, aval shelosha al shelosha — mittamme! tere miute ketivi: "beged tzemer o [beveged] pishtim" — chad lemaote mishshalosh al shalosh, vechad lemaote mishshelosha al shelosha.
Ulerava deamar shelosha al shelosha bishar begadim ikka benayyhu, lerabbi shimon ben elazar it leh, letanna deve rabbi yishmael let leh — shelosha al shelosha bishar begadim

a: Mena leh? nafka meo veged". detanya: "beged" — en li ella beged, shelosha al shelosha bishar begadim minnayin? talmud lomar: "o veged".
Veabbaye, hay "o veged" may aved leh? mibbee leh lerabbot shalosh al shalosh betzemer ufishtim demittamme bishratzim.
Verava, galli rachamana gabbe negaim, vehu haddin lishratzim.
Veabbaye, ikka lemifrach: ma lingaim shekken sheti vaerev mittamme bahem.
Veiddach: i salka datach negaim chamiri, lichtov rachamana gabbe sheratzim veletu negaim minnayyhu.
Veiddach: negaim mishsheratzim la atu, deikka lemifrach: ma lishratzim shekken metammein bechaadasha.

Amar abbaye: hay tanna deve rabbi yishmael mappek meidach tanna deve rabbi yishmael. detane deve rabbi yishmael "beged" — en li ella beged tzemer ufishtim, minnayin lerabbot tzemer gemallim vetzemer arnavim, notza shel izzim vehashshirin vehakkalach vehasserikin? — talmud lomar: "o veged".
Rava amar: ki let leh lehach tanna deve rabbi yishmael bishar begadim shalosh al shalosh, shelosha al shelosha it leh.
Veha rava hu deamar shelosha al shelosha bishar begadim, lerabbi shimon ben elazar it leh, letanna deve rabbi yishmael let leh! hadar beh rava mehahi. vei baet ema, ha rav pappa amra.
Rav pappa amar: af kol, leetuye kilayim. kilayim behedya ketivi beh: "lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav"! salka datach amena, hane mille derech levisha, aval behaalaa kol tere mine asur.
Velav kal vachomer hu? uma levisha deka mithane kulle gufeh mikkilayim, amrat tzemer ufishtim — en, midde acharina la. haalaa lo kol shekken? ella derav pappa beduta hi.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: af kol
b: Leetuye tzitzit. tzitzit behedya ketiv: "lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim", uchetiv: "gedilim taase lach"! salka datach amena kidrava. derava rame, ketiv: "hakkanaf", min kanaf. uchetiv: "tzemer ufishtim yachdav", ha chetzad? tzemer ufishtim potrin ben beminan, ben shello beminan. shear minin beminan potrin shello beminan en potrin. salka datach kidrava ka mashma lan.

Amar rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: letanna deve rabbi yishmael, may shena leinyan tumea dimrabbe shear begadim, dichtiv — "o veged", hacha name lema lerabbot shear begadim measher techasse bah"? hahu — leetuye kesut some hu daata. detanya: "ureitem oto" — perat lichsut layla. atta omer perat lichsut layla, o eno ella perat lichsut some? keshehu omer "asher techasse bah", hare kesut some amur. ha ma ani mekayyem "ureitem oto" — perat lichsut layla.
Uma raita lerabbot some ulehotzi kesut layla? merabbe ani kesut some sheyyeshnah biriyyay etzel acherim, umotzi ani kesut layla sheenah biriyyay etzel acherim.
Veema lerabbot shear begadim? mistabbera kae betzemer ufishtim merabbe tzemer ufishtim. kae betzemer ufishtim merabbe shear begadim?!
Amar abbaye: rabbi shimon ben elazar vesomchos amru davar echad. rabbi shimon ben elazar ha daamaran. somchos — detanya: somchos omer sikkechah bitvivy pesula mippene shemmittammea bingaim.
Keman — ki hay tanna, ditnan: sheti vaerev mittamme bingaim miyyad, divre rabbi meir. verabbi yehuda omer: hashsheti mishsheyyishshale, vehaerev miyyad, vehaunnin shel pishtan mishsheyyitlabbenu.
Mishna kol hayyotze min haetz en madlikin bo, ella pishtan. vechol hayyotze min haetz eno mittamme tumeat ohalim, ella pishtan.
Gemara menalan defishtan ikkeri "etz"? amar mar zutera: deamar kera "vehi heelatam haggaga vattitmenem befishte haetz".
Vehayyotze min haetz eno mittamme tumeat ohalim, ella pishtan. menalan? amar rabbi elazar: gamar "ohel" "ohel"

a: Mimmishkan. ketiv hacha: "zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel", uchetiv hatam: "vayyifros et haohel al hammishkan". ma lehallan shel pishtan karuy "ohel" — af kan shel pishtan karuy "ohel". i ma lehallan shezurin vechutan kaful shishsha, af kan shezurin vechutan kaful shishsha? — talmud lomar: "ohel" "ohel" ribba. i "ohel" "ohel" ribba, afillu kol mille name! im ken gezera shava may ahani leh?!

Veema: ma lehallan kerashim, af kan kerashim! amar kera "veasita kerashim lammishkan". mishkan karuy mishkan, veen kerashim keruyin mishkan. ella meatta, "veasita michse laohel" — hachi name michse la ikkeri "ohel". ella ha devae rabbi elazar: or behema temea mahu sheyyittamme beohel hammet. hasheta or behema tehora la mittamme, or behema temea mibbaya?! — shane hatam dahadar ahdereh kera, dichtiv: "venasu et yeriot hammishkan veet ohel moed michsehu umichse hattachash asher alav". makkish elyon letachton — ma tachton karuy "ohel", af elyon karuy "ohel".

Gufa. bae rabbi elazar: or behema temea mahu sheyyittamme tumeat ohalin. may kamibbaya leh? amar rav adda bar ahava: tachash shehaya bime moshe kamibbaya leh — tame haya o tahor haya? amar rav yosef: may tibbee leh, tenena: lo hucheshru limlechet shamayim ella or behema tehora bilvad!

Metiv rabbi abba, rabbi yehuda omer: shene michsaot hayu, echad shel orot elim meaddamim veechad shel orot techashim. rabbi nechemya omer: michse echad haya, vedome kemin tela ilan. veha tela ilan tame hu! hachi kaamar: kemin tela ilan hu, sheyyesh bo gevonin harebe, velo tela ilan. deillu hatam tame, vehacha tahor. amar rav yosef: i hachi hayeynu dimtargeminan "sasgona", shessas bigvonin harebe.

Rava amar: or behema temea demittamme beohel hammet mehacha, detanya: "or" "o veor" — ribba or behema temea. veshellaka beyad kohen, katzatz mikkullan veasa achat mehen, minnayin? — talmud lomar: "o bechol melechet or". veikka lemifrach, ma lingaim shekken sheti vaerev tame bahen.

Ella gamar mishsheratzim: detanya: "or" — en li ella or behema tehora, or behema temea minnayin? talmud lomar "o or". veikka lemifrach: ma lishratzim shekken metammein bechaadasha. negaim yochichu. vechazar haddin, lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen — sheor tame bahen, veasa or behema temea keor behema tehora. af ani avi ohel hammet sheor tame bo, venaase bo or behema temea keor behema tehora.
Amar leh rava mibbarnish lerav ashe: ikka lemifrach — ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken temein befachot mikkezayit, tomar bemet sheeno metamme ella bichzayit.
Ella amar rava mibbarnish:
b: Atya bekal vachomer minnotza shel izzim, sheen mittamme bingaim — mittamme beohel hammet, or behema temea shemmittammea bingaim — eno din shemmittammea beohel hammet.

Veella ha detane rav yosef lo hucheshru bimlechet shamayim ella or behema tehora bilvad — lemay hilcheta? litfillin. tefillin behedya ketiv behu "lemaan tihye torat Adonai beficha", min hammuttar befich!
Ella leoran. vehaamar abbaye: shin shel tefillin halacha lemoshe missinay!
Ella lechorchan besaaran uletofran begidan. ha name halacha lemoshe missinay hu, detanya: tefillin merubbaot — halacha lemoshe missinay, nichrachot besaaran venitparot begidan!
Ella lirtzuot. vehaamar rabbi yitzchak retzuot shechorot halacha lemoshe missinay? nehi digmiri shechorot, tehorot mi gemiri?

May have ale detachash shehaya bime moshe? amar rabbi illaa amar rabbi shimon ben lakish, omer haya rabbi meir: tachash shehaya bime moshe beriyya bifne atzmah haya, velo hichriu bo chachamim im min chayya hu, im min behema hu. vekeren achat hayta lo bemitzcho, ulefi shaa nizdammen lo lemoshe veasa mimmennu mishkan venignaz.

Middekaamar keren achat hayta lo bemitzcho, shema minna tahor haya, deamar rav yehuda: shor shehikriv adam harishon keren achat hayta lo bemitzcho, shenneemar: "vetitav laAdonai mishshor par makrin mafris". "makrin" tarte mashma! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak — "makran" ketiv. velifshot minneh demin behema hu? kevan deikka "keresh" demin chayya hu velet leh ella chada keren — ikka lememar min chayya hu.
Mishna petilat habbeged shekkippelah velo hivhavah, rabbi eliezer omer: temea hi, veen madlikin bah. rabbi akiva omer tehora hi, umadlikin bah.
Gemara bishlama leinyan tumea, beha peligi: derabbi eliezer savar kippul eno moil, uvemilletay kammayyta kayyma. verabbi akiva savar kippul moil, uvattole battela.

Ella leinyan hadelaka bemay peligi? amar rabbi elazar amar rav oshaya, vechen amar rav adda bar ahava: hacha beshalosh al shalosh metzumetzamot askinan, uveyom tov shechal lihyot erev shabbat askinan. dechulle alma it lehu derabbi yehuda deamar: massikin bechelim veen massikin beshivre chelim. udechulle alma it lehu deulla, deamar ulla: hammadlik tzarich sheyyadlik barov hayyotze. rabbi eliezer savar kippul eno moil, vechevan deadlek beh pureta havya leh shever keli, vechi ka madlek — beshever keli kamadlek. verabbi akiva savar kippul moil, veen torat keli alav, vechi kamadlek — beetz bealma kamadlek.
Amar rav yosef, hayeynu detanena: "shalosh al shalosh metzumetzamot" vela yadana lemay hilcheta.
Umiddeka metaretz rav adda bar ahava allibba derabbi yehuda, shema minna kerabbi yehuda sevira leh. umi amar rav adda bar ahava hachi? vehaamar rav adda bar ahava:

a: Goy shechakak kav bivkaat — yisrael massikah beyom tov. veammay? nolad hu! ledivrehem derabbi eliezer verabbi akiva kaamar leh, veleh la sevira leh.

Rava amar, hayeynu tama derabbi eliezer: lefi sheen madlikin biftila sheenah mechorechet velo bismartutin sheenan mechorachin. ella ha detane rav yosef "shalosh al shalosh metzumetzamot" lemay hilcheta? leinyan tumea. ditnan: shalosh al shalosh sheamru — chutz min hammelal, divre rabbi shimon. vachachamim omrim: shalosh al shalosh mechuuonot.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: massikin bechelim veen massikin beshivre chelim, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi shimon mattir. massikin bitmarin, achalan en massikin begarinehen, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi shimon mattir. massikin beegozim, achalan en massikin biklippotehen, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi shimon mattir.

Utzericha. dei ashmeinan kammayyta, behahi kaamar rabbi yehuda, mishshum demeikkara keli vehasheta shever keli, vehave leh nolad, veasur. aval temarim, demeikkara garinin vehasheta garinin — ema shappir dame. vei ashmeinan garinin, hava amena demeikkara mikkasseyayn vehasheta miggalleyayn. aval kelippe egozin, demeikkara miggallu vehasheta miggallu — ema shappir dame. tzericha.
Veha derav lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar. derav achal tamre usheda kashyayta levucheya. amar leh rabbi chiyyay: bar pachate, kenegdo beyom tov asur. kabbela minneh o la kabbela minneh?
Ta shema: dechi ata rav levavel, achal tamre usheda kashyayta lechevata. may lav befarsayayta, vela kabbela? — la, baarammayata — hoil vachaze aggav immayyhu.

Amar leh rav shemuel bar bar chana lerav yosef: lerabbi yehuda deamar massikin bechelim veen massikin beshivre chelim, kevan deadlek behu pureta have leh shivre chelim, vechi ka mehappech — beissura ka mehappech? — daavad kidrav matna. deamar rav matna amar rav: etzim shennashru min haddekel letannur beyom tov, marbe etzim muchanin umassikan.
Rav hamenuna amar: hacha befachot mishshelosha al shelosha askinan, mikkulle matlaniyyot shanu kan.

Veazda rabbi eliezer letameh verabbi akiva letameh. ditnan: pachot mishshelosha al shelosha shehitkino lifkok bo et hammerchatz ulenaer bo et hakkedera ulekanneach bo et harechayim — ben min hammuchan uven sheen min hammuchan — tame, divre rabbi eliezer. verabbi yehoshua omer: ben min hammuchan uven shello min hammuchan — tahor. rabbi akiva omer: min hammuchan — tame, veshello min hammuchan — tahor. veamar ulla, veittema rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim zerako baashpa — divre hakkol tahor.
b: Hinnicho bekufesa — divre hakkol tame. lo nechleku ella shettelao bemaggod o shehinnicho laachore haddelet. rabbi eliezer savar middelo zerako baashpa dateh illaveh. umay kare leh "shello min hammuchan" — dilgabbe kufesa lav muchan hu. verabbi yehoshua savar middelo hinnicho bekufesa battole batteleh, umay kare leh "muchan" — dilgabbe ashpa muchan hu. verabbi akiva, bitlao bemaggod savar kerabbi eliezer, behinnicho achore haddelet savar la kerabbi yehoshua.

Vahadar beh rabbi akiva legabbeh derabbi yehoshua. mimmay? amar rava: middekatane "petilat habbeged". may irya detane "petilat habbeged"? litne "petila shel beged". may "petilat habbeged" — daadayin beged hu.

Mishna lo yikkov adam shefoferet shel betza vimalleenna shemen veyittenenna al pi hanner bishvil shettehe menattefet, vaafillu hi shel cheres. verabbi yehuda mattir. aval im chibberah hayyotzer mittechilla — muttar, mippene shehu keli echad. lo yemalle adam keara shel shemen veyittenenna betzad hanner veyitten rosh happetila betochah bishvil shettehe shoevet. verabbi yehuda mattir.

Gemara utzericha. dei ashmeinan shefoferet shel betza — beha kaamri rabbanan, dechevan dela meisa ate leistappoke minna. aval shel cheres dimisa — ema modu leh lerabbi yehuda. vei ashmeinan shel cheres — beha kaamar rabbi yehuda, aval behahi — ema mode lehu lerabbanan. vei ashmeinan hanach tarte, behane kaamar rabbi yehuda mishshum dela mippesak, aval keara demippaska — ema mode lehu lerabbanan. vei ashmeinan behahi, behahi kaamri rabbanan, aval behane tarte — ema modu lerabbi yehuda. tzericha.
Veim chibberah hayyotzer mittechilla muttar vechulei. tana im chibberah besid uvecharsit muttar. vehaanan "yotzer" tenan! may "yotzer", keen yotzer.

Tanya amar rabbi yehuda: paam achat shavatnu baaliyyayt bet natteza belod, veheviu lanu shefoferet shel betza umillenuha shemen unekavnuha vehinnachnuha al pi hanner. vehaya sham rabbi tarfon uzekenim, velo amru lanu davar. amru lo: mishsham reaya?! shane bet natteza dizrizin hen.

Avin tzipporaa gerar safsalla beillita deshesha leilla merabbi yitzchak ben elazar. amar leh: i shetiki lach kedishtiku leh chavrayya lerabbi yehuda nafek minneh chureba. gezera illita deshesha attu illita dealma.

Resh kenishta devotzra gerar safsalla leella merabbi yirmeya rabba. amar leh: keman, kerabbi shimon? — emar deamar rabbi shimon bigdolim dela efshar, biktannim mi amar?! ufeliga deulla. deamar ulla machaloket biktannim, aval bigdolim divre hakkol muttar.
Metiv rav yosef: rabbi shimon omer gorer adam mitta kisse vesafsal, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot charitz. katane gedolim, vekatane ketannim, kashya letarvavyyhu!
Ulla metaretz letameh verabbi yirmeya rabba metaretz letameh: ulla metaretz letameh — mitta dumeya dechisse. verabbi yirmeya rabba metaretz letameh — kisse dumeya demitta.

Metiv rabba: mochre kesut mochrin kedarkan, uvilvad shello yitkavven bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim, vehatztzenuin mafshilin bemakkel laachorehen. veha hacha deefshar lemibad kitznuin — dechi ketannim dame, vechi la mitkavven — share rabbi shimon lechattechilla. teyuveta derabbi yirmeya rabba. teyuveta.

Mishna hamechabbe et hanner mippene shehu mityare mippene goyim umippene listim, mippene ruach raa, mippene hachole sheyyishan — patur. kechas al hanner, kechas al hashshemen, kechas al happetila — chayyayv. rabbi yose poter bechullan, chutz min happetila — mippene shehu osah pecham.

a: Gemara middekatane sefa chayyayv — shema minna rabbi yehuda hi. resha bemay askinan? i bechole sheyyesh bo sakkana — "muttar" mibbee leh. vei bechole sheen bo sakkana "chayyayv chattat" mibbee leh!

Leolam bechole sheyyesh bo sakkana, uvedin hu delitne "muttar", veayyeyde devae lemitne sefa "chayyayv", tena name resha "patur". vehadtane rabbi oshaya im bishvil hachole sheyyishan lo yechabbe, veim kibba, patur aval asur! — hahi bechole sheen bo sakkana, verabbi shimon hi.

Sheul sheela zo leella merabbi tanchum demin noy: mahu lechabbot butzina denura mikkamme beisha beshabbeta? petach vaamar: ant shelomo an chochmetach, an sucheltanutach? lo dayyekka sheddevarecha sotrin divre david avicha, ella sheddevarecha sotrin ze et ze. david avicha amar: "lo hammetim yehallu yah", veat amarta: "veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu", vechazarta veamarta: "ki lechelev chay hu tov min haarye hammet"!

La kashya, ha dekaamar david "lo hammetim yehallu yah" — hachi kaamar: leolam yaasok adam betora uvemitzvot kodem sheyyamut, shekkevan shemmet, batel min hattora umin hammitzvot veen lehakkadosh baruch hu shevach bo. vehayeynu deamar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv: "bammetim chofshi" — kevan shemmet adam naase chofshi min hattora umin hammitzvot.

Udekaamar shelomo "veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu", shekkeshechatu yisrael bammidbar, amad moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu veamar kamma tefillot vetachanunim lefanav velo naana, uchesheamar "zechor leavraham leyitzchak uleyisrael avadecha" — miyyad naana. velo yafe amar shelomo "veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu"? davar acher: minhago shel olam, melech basar vadam gozer gezera — safek mekayyeymin otah safek en mekayyeymin otah. veim timtze lomar mekayyeymin otah — bechayyav mekayyeymin otah bemoto en mekayyeymin otah. veillu moshe rabbenu gazar kamma gezerot vetikken kamma takkanot vekayyaymot hen leolam uleolme olamim. velo yafe amar shelomo "veshabbeach ani et hammetim vegomer"?!

Davar acher: "veshabbeach ani vegomer", kidrav yehuda amar rav. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: may dichtiv "ase immi ot letova veyiru sonay veyevoshu" — amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, mechol li al oto avon. amar lo: machul lach. amar lo: ase immi ot bechayyay. amar lo: bechayyecha eni modia, bechayyay shelomo bincha ani modia.

Keshebbana shelomo et bet hammikdash, bikkesh lehachenis aron levet kodshe hakkodashim. davku shearim ze baze. amar shelomo esrim vearbaa renanot, velo naana. patach veamar: "seu shearim rashechem vehinnasu pitche olam veyavo melech hakkavod". rehatu batreh lemivleeh, amaru: "mi hu ze melech hakkavod". amar lehu: "Adonai izzuz vegibbor". chazar veamar: "seu shearim rashechem useu pitche olam veyavo melech hakkavod mi hu ze melech hakkavod Adonai tzevaot hu melech hakkavod sela", velo naana. kevan sheamar: "Adonai elohim al tashev pene meshichecha zachra lechasde david avdecha", miyyad naana. beotah shaa nehpechu pene kol sone david keshule kedera, vayyedu chol haam vechol yisrael shemmachal lo hakkadosh baruch hu al oto avon. velo yafe amar shelomo: "veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu"?!

Vehayeynu dichtiv: "bayyom hashshemini shillach et haam vayvarachu et hammelech vayyelchu leoholehem semechim vetove lev al kol hattova asher asa Adonai ledavid avdo uleyisrael ammo". "vayyelchu leoholehem" — shemmatzu neshotehen betohora. "semechim" — shennehenu mizziv hashshechina. "vetove lev" — shennitabberu neshotehen shel kol echad veechad veyalda zachar. "al kol hattova asher asa Adonai ledavid avdo (uleyisrael ammo". "ledavid avdo)" — shemmachal lo al oto avon. "uleyisrael ammo" — deachel lehu avon deyom hakkippurim.

Udekaamar shelomo: "ki lechelev chay hu tov min haarye hammet", kidrav yehuda amar rav. deamar rav yehuda amar rav, may dichtiv: "hodieni Adonai kitztzi umiddat yamay ma hi eda me chadel ani" — amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, hodieni Adonai kitztzi. amar lo: gezera hi millefanay sheen modiin kitztzo shel basar vadam. "umiddat yamay ma hi" — gezera hi millefanay sheen modiin middat yamav shel adam. "veeda me chadel ani" — amar lo: beshabbat tamut. amut beechad beshabbat? amar lo: kevar higgia malchut shelomo bincha, veen malchut nogaat bachavertah afillu kimlo nima. amut beerev shabbat? amar lo: "ki tov yom bachatzerecha mealef" — tov li yom echad sheatta yoshev veosek battora meelef olot sheatid shelomo bincha lehakeriv lefanay al gabbe hammizbeach.
b: Kol yoma deshabbeta hava yatev vegares kulle yoma. hahu yoma devae lemenach nafsheh, kam malach hammavet kammeh vela yechil leh, dela hava pasek pummeh miggirsa. amar: may aaved leh? hava leh busetana achore beteh, ata malach hammavet salek uvachesh beilane. nefak lemichze. hava salek bedarga, ippechit darga mittuteh, ishtik venach nafsheh.

Shelach shelomo leve midresha: abba met umutal bachamma, uchelavim shel bet abba reevim — ma eese? shelachu leh: chatoch nevela vehannach lifne hakkelavim. veavich, hannach alav kikkar o tinok vetaltelo. velo yafe amar shelomo: "ki lechelev chay hu tov min haarye hammet". uleinyan sheela deshaelna kodamechon: ner keruya "ner", venishmato shel adam keruya "ner". mutav tichbe ner shel basar vadam mippene nero shel hakkadosh baruch hu.

Amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: bikkeshu chachamim lignoz sefer kohelet mippene sheddevarav sotrin ze et ze. umippene ma lo genazuhu? — mippene shettechillato divre tora vesofo divre tora. techillato divre tora, dichtiv: "ma yitron laadam bechol amalo sheyyaamol tachat hashshemesh" — veamri deve rabbi yannay tachat hashshemesh hu deen lo. kodem shemesh — yesh lo. sofo divre tora, dichtiv: "sof davar hakkol nishma et haelohim yera veet mitzvotav shemor ki ze kol haadam". may "ki ze kol haadam"? — amar rabbi (eliezer) [elazar]: kol haolam kullo lo nivra ella bishvil ze. rabbi abba bar kahana amar: shakul ze keneged kol haolam kullo. shimon ben azzay omer, veamri la shimon ben zoma omer: lo nivra kol haolam kullo ella litzvot laze.

Umay "devarav sotrin ze et ze"? ketiv: "tov kaas missechok", uchetiv "lischok amarti meholal"! ketiv "veshibbachti ani et hassimcha", uchetiv "ulesimcha ma zo osa! la kashya "tov kaas missechok": tov kaas shekkoes hakkadosh baruch hu al hatztzaddikim baolam hazze, missechok shemmesachek hakkadosh baruch hu al harshaim baolam hazze. velishchok amarti meholal" — ze sechok shemmesachek hakkadosh baruch hu im hatztzaddikim baolam habba.

"Veshibbachti ani et hassimcha" — simcha shel mitzva. "ulesimcha ma zo osa" — zo simcha sheenah shel mitzva. lelammedcha sheen shechina shora lo mittoch atzvut velo mittoch atzlut velo mittoch sechok velo mittoch kallut rosh velo mittoch sicha velo mittoch devarim betelim, ella mittoch devar simcha shel mitzva, shenneemar: "veatta kechu li menaggen vehaya kenaggen hamenaggen vattehi alav yad Adonai". amar rav yehuda: vechen lidvar halacha. amar rava: vechen lachalom tov.

Ini, vehaamar rav giddel amar rav: kol talmid chacham sheyyoshev lifne rabbo veen siftotav notfot mar, tikkavena, shenneemar: "siftotav shoshannim notfot mor over": al tikre "mor over", ella "mar over". al tikre "shoshannim", ella "sheshshonim". la kashya: ha berabba veha betalmida. veibbaet ema ha veha berabba, vela kashya: ha mikkamme deliftach, ha levatar diftach. ki ha derabba mikkamme defatach lehu lerabbanan amar milleta divdichuta uvadchi rabbanan, lesof yatev beemta ufatach bishmata.

Veaf sefer mishle bikkeshu lignoz shehayu devarav sotrin ze et ze. umippene ma lo genazuhu? amri: sefer kohelet lav ayyninan veashkechinan tama? hacha name liayyen. umay devarav sotrim ze et ze? — ketiv "al taan kesil keivvalto", uchetiv: "ane chesil keivvalto". la kashya: ha bedivre tora, ha bemille dealma.

Ki ha dehahu daata lekammeh derabbi amar leh: ishtecha ishti, uvanecha banay. amar leh: retzonecha shettishte kos shel yayin? shata ufaka. hahu daata lekammeh derabbi chiyyay, amar leh: immecha ishti, veatta beni. amar leh: retzonecha shettishte kos shel yayin? shata ufaka. amar rabbi chiyyay: ahneya leh tzeloteh lerabbi dela leshauoyeh bene mamzere. derabbi ki hava metzalle amar: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu, shettatztzileni hayyom meazze panim umeazzut panim".

Bedivre tora may hi? — ki ha deyatev rabban gamliel veka daresh: atida ishsha shetteled bechol yom, shenneemar "hara veyoledet yachdav". ligleg alav oto talmid, amar: "en kol chadash tachat hashshamesh"! amar leh: bo vearekka dugematan baolam hazze. nefak achvi leh tarnegolet.

Vetu, yatev rabban gamliel veka daresh: atidim ilanot shemmotziin perot bechol yom, shenneemar: "venasa anaf veasa feri" — me anaf bechol yom af peri bechol yom. ligleg alav oto talmid, amar: vehachtiv "en kol chadash tachat hashshamesh". amar leh: bo vearekka dugematam baolam hazze. nefak achvi leh tzalaf.

Vetu, yatev rabban gamliel veka daresh: atida eretz yisrael shettotzi gelusekaot uchele melat shenneemar: "yehi fissat bar baaretz". ligleg alav oto talmid veamar: "en kol chadash tachat hashshamesh". amar leh: bo vearekka dugematan baolam hazze. nefak achvi leh kemehin ufitriyyot. veakkele melat — nevara bar kora.
Tanu rabbanan: leolam yehe adam anvevtan kehillel veal yehe kappedan keshammay. maase bishne bene adam

a: Shehimru ze et ze, amru: kol mi sheyyelech veyaknit et hillel yittol arba meot zuz. amar echad mehem: ani aknitennu. oto hayyom erev shabbat haya, vehillel chafaf et rosho. halach veavar al petach beto, amar: mi kan hillel, mi kan hillel? nitattef veyatza likrato. amar lo: beni, ma atta mevakkesh? amar lo: sheela yesh li lishol. amar lo: sheal beni. sheal: mippene ma rashehen shel bavliyyim segalgallot? amar lo: beni, sheela gedola shaalta. mippene sheen lahem chayyot pikkechot.

Halach vehimtin shaa achat, chazar veamar: mi kan hillel, mi kan hillel? nitattef veyatza likrato. amar lo: beni, ma atta mevakkesh? amar lo: sheela yesh li lishol. amar lo: sheal beni. sheal: mippene ma enehen shel tarmodiyyin terutot? amar lo: beni, sheela gedola shaalta. mippene sheddarin ben hacholot.

Halach vehimtin shaa achat, chazar veamar: mi kan hillel, mi kan hillel? nitattef veyatza likrato, amar lo: beni, ma atta mevakkesh? amar lo: sheela yesh li lishol. amar lo: sheal beni. sheal: mippene ma raglehem shel afrikiyyim rechavot? amar lo: beni sheela gedola shaalta — mippene sheddarin ben bitze hammayim.

Amar lo: sheelot harebe yesh li lishol, umityare ani shemma tichos. nitattef veyashav lefanav. amar lo: kol sheelot sheyyesh lach lishol sheal. amar lo atta hu hillel shekkorin otcha "nesi yisrael"? amar lo: hen. amar lo: im atta hu, lo yirbu kemotcha beyisrael. amar lo: beni, mippene ma? amar lo mippene sheibbadti al yadcha arba meot zuz. amar lo: heve zahir beruchacha keday hu hillel shetteabbed al yado arba meot zuz vearba meot zuz, vehillel lo yakpid.

Tanu rabbanan: maase begoy echad shebba lifne shammay. amar lo: kamma torot yesh lachem? amar lo: shetayim, tora shebbichtav vetora shebbeal pe. amar lo: shebbichtav ani maamincha, veshebbeal pe — eni maamincha. gayyeyreni al menat shettelammedeni tora shebbichtav. gaar bo vehotzio binzifa. ba lifne hillel, gayyreh. yoma kamma amar leh: 3 7. limchar afech leh. amar leh: veha etmol la amart li hachi! amar leh: lav alay didi ka samchat? deal pe name semoch alay.

Shuv maase begoy echad shebba lifne shammay. amar lo: gayyeyreni al menat shettelammedeni kol hattora kullah kesheani omed al regel achat! dechafo beammat habbinyan shebbeyado. ba lifne hillel, gayyreh. amar lo: daalach sene lechavrach la taaved — zo hi kol hattora kullah, veiddach perushah hu, zil gemor.

Shuv maase begoy echad shehaya over achore bet hammidrash, veshama kol sofer shehaya omer: "veelle habbegadim asher yaasu choshen veefod". amar: hallalu lemi? amru lo: lechohen gadol. amar oto goy beatzmo: elech veetgayyer bishvil sheyyesimuni kohen gadol. ba lifne shammay, amar lo: gayyeyreni al menat shettesimeni kohen gadol. dechafo beammat habbinyan shebbeyado. ba lifne hillel, gayyreh.

Amar lo: kelum maamidin melech ella mi sheyyodea tachsise malchut, lech lemod tachsise malchut. halach vekara. kevan shehiggia "vehazzar hakkarev yumat", amar leh: mikra ze al mi neemar? amar lo: afillu al david melech yisrael. nasa oto ger kal vachomer beatzmo: uma yisrael shennikreu banim lammakom umittoch ahava sheahavam kera lahem: "beni bechori yisrael", ketiv alehem "vehazzar hakkarev yumat" — ger hakkal shebba bemaklo uvetarmilo, al achat kamma vechamma.

Ba lifne shammay, amar lo: kelum rauy ani lihyot kohen gadol? vahalo ketiv battora: "vehazzar hakkarev yumat". ba lifne hillel, amar lo: anvevtan hillel, yanuchu lecha berachot al roshcha, shekkeravtani tachat kanfe hashshechina. leyamim nizdavvevgu shelashtan limkom echad, amru: kappedanuto shel shammay bikkesha letordenu min haolam, invevtanuto shel hillel kervatnu tachat kanfe hashshechina.

Amar resh lakish: may dichtiv "vehaya emunat ittecha chosen yeshuot chochmat vadaat vegomer". "emunat" — ze seder zeraim. "ittecha" — ze seder moed. "chosen" — ze seder nashim. "yeshuot" — ze seder nezikin. "chochmat" — ze seder kodashim. "vadaat" — ze seder teharot. vaafillu hachi, "yirat Adonai hi otzaro".

Amar rava: beshaa shemmachnisin adam ledin, omrim lo: nasata venatatta baemuna? kavata ittim lattora? asakta bifriyya ureviyya? tzippita lishua? pilpalta bechochma? hevanta davar mittoch davar? vaafillu hachi, i yirat Adonai hi otzaro — in, i la — la. mashal leadam sheamar lishlucho: haale li kor chittin laaliyyay. halach veheela lo. amar lo: eravta li bahen kav chomton? amar lo: lav. amar lo: mutav im lo heeleta.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: mearev adam kav chomton bechor shel tevua, veeno choshesh.
Amar rabba bar rav huna: kol adam sheyyesh bo tora veen bo
b: Yirat shamayim, dome legizbar shemmasru lo maftechot happenimiyyot umaftechot hachitzonot lo masru lo, behe ayel? machriz rabbi yannay: chaval al delet leh darta vetara ledarta aved. amar rav yehuda: lo bara hakkadosh baruch hu et olamo ella kede sheyyiru millefanav, shenneemar: "vehaelohim asa sheyyiru millefanav".

Rabbi simon verabbi elazar havo yatvi. chalef veazel rabbi yaakov bar acha. amar leh chad lechavreh: neku mikkammeh, digvar dachel chetin hu. amar leh iddach: neku mikkammeh, digvar bar oryayn hu. amar leh: amena lach ana digvar dachel chetin hu, veamrat li at bar oryayn hu?!

Tistayyem derabbi elazar hu deamar digvar dachel chetin hu. deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi elazar: en lo lehakkadosh baruch hu beolamo ella yirat shamayim bilvad, shenneemar: "veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach ki im leyira vegomer", uchetiv: "vayyomer laadam hen yirat Adonai hi chochma vegomer" — shekken belashon yevani korin leachat "hen". tistayyem.
Daresh rav ulla: may dichtiv "al tirsha harebe vegomer" — harebe hu dela lirsha, ha meat lirsha?! ella: mi sheachal shum verecho nodef yachzor veyochal shum acher vihe recho nodef?!

Daresh rava bar rav ulla: may dichtiv "ki en chartzubbot lemotam uvari ulam" — amar hakkadosh baruch hu: lo dayyayn larshaim sheenan charedin vaatzevin miyyom hammita, ella shellibbam bari lahen keulam. vehayeynu deamar rabba may dichtiv "ze darkam kesel lamo" — yodin reshaim sheddarkam lemita, veyesh lahem chelev al kislam. shemma tomar shichcha hi mehen? talmud lomar: "veacharehem befihem yirtzu sela".

Kechas al hanner kulei. rabbi yose keman sevira leh? i kerabbi yehuda sevira leh, afillu behanach name lichayyev! vei kerabbi shimon sevira leh, petila name liftar. amar ulla: leolam kerabbi yehuda sevira leh, vekasavar rabbi yose soter al menat livnot bimkomo have soter. al menat livnot shello bimkomo — la have soter.

Amar leh rabba: mikkede kol melachot yalfinan lehu mimmishkan, vehatam soter al menat livnot shello bimkomo hu! amar leh: shane hatam kevan dichtiv "al pi Adonai yachanu", kesoter al menat livnot bimkomo dame.

Verabbi yochanan amar: leolam kerabbi shimon sevira leh. umay shena petila? kidamar rav hamenuna, veittema rav adda bar ahava: hacha biftila shetztzarich lehavehavah askinan, divhahi afillu rabbi shimon mode, deka metakken mana. amar rava: dayka name, dekatane shehu osah pecham, vela katane mippene shennaaset pecham. shema minna.
Mishna al shalosh averot nashim metot bishat ledatan: al sheenan zehirot bannidda, bachalla, uvehadlakat hanner.

Gemara nidda may tama? amar rabbi yitzchak: hi kilkela bechadre vitnah, lefichach tilke bechadre vitnah. tinach nidda — challa vehadelakat hanner may ikka lememar? kedidrash hahu galilaa aleh derav chisda, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: reviit dam natatti bachem — al iske dam hizharti etchem.

a: "Reshit" karati etchem — al iske reshit hizharti etchem. neshama shennatatti bachem keruya "ner" — al iske ner hizharti etchem. im attem mekayyeymim otam — mutav, veim lav — hareni notel nishmatchem.

Umay shena bishat ledatan? amar rava: nefal tora — chadded lesakkina. abbaye amar: tappish terus ammeta, bechad machtera leheve. rav chisda amar: shivkeh leravya, deminnafsheh nafel. mar ukeva amar: raaya chagira veizze rahatan, abbav chutera mille, veabbe dare chushebana. rav pappa amar: abbav chanvata nefishi ache umerachame, abbav bizyone — la ache vela merachame.

Vegavre hecha mibbadki? amar resh lakish: beshaa sheovrim al haggesher. gesher vetu la? ema: keen gesher. rav la avar bemabbara deyatev beh goy, amar: dilma mippekid leh dina aleh umittefisna bahadeh. shemuel la avar ella bemabbara deit beh goy, amar: sitna bitre umme la shalet.

Rabbi yannay badek veavar. rabbi yannay letameh, deamar: leolam al yaamod adam bemakom sakkana lomar sheosin lo nes, shemma en osin lo nes. veim osin lo nes — menakkin lo mizzechuyotav. amar rabbi chanin: may keraa? — "katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkol haemet". rabbi zera beyoma deshuta la nafek levene dikle.

Amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda: leolam yevakkesh adam rachamim shello yechele, sheim yechele omrim lo: have zechut vehippater. amar mar ukeva: may keraa? — "ki yippol hannofel mimmennu" — mimmennu lehavi reaya. tana deve rabbi yishmael: "ki yippol hannofel mimmennu" (mimmennu) — rauy ze lippol mishsheshet yeme vereshit, shehare lo nafal, vehakkatuv kerao "nofel". ella, shemgalgelin zechut al yede zakkay vechova al yede chayyayv.

Tanu rabbanan: mi shechala venata lamut, omrim lo: hitvadde, shekken kol hammumatin mitvaddin. adam yotze lashshuk, yehi dome beenav kemi shennimsar lesardeyot. chash berosho — yehi dome beenav kemi shennetanuhu bekolar. ala lammitta venafal — yehi dome beenav kemi sheheluhu laggardom liddon, shekkol haole laggardom liddon im yesh lo peraklitin gedolim — nitztzol, veim lav — eno nitztzol.

Veellu hen peraklitin shel adam: teshuva umaasim tovim. vaafillu tesha meot vetishim vetisha melammedim alav chova veechad melammed alav zechut — nitztzol, shenneemar: "im yesh alav malach melitz echad minni alef lehaggid leadam yoshro. vaychunnennu vayyomer pedaehu meredet shachat vegomer". rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer: afillu tesha meot vetishim vetisha beoto malach lechova veechad lizchut — nitztzol, shenneemar: "melitz echad minni alef".

Tanu rabbanan: al shalosh averot nashim metot yoldot. rabbi elazar omer nashim metot yeladot. rabbi acha omer beavon shemmechabbesot tzoat benehem beshabbat. veyesh omrim: al shekkorin laaron hakkodesh "arana".

Tanya, rabbi yishmael ben elazar omer: baavon shene devarim amme haaratzot metim — al shekkorin laaron hakkodesh "arana", veal shekkorin levet hakkeneset "bet am". tanya rabbi yose omer: shelosha bidke mita nivreu baishsha, veamri la: shelosha divke mita: nidda vechalla vehadelakat hanner. chada kerabbi elazar vachada kerabbanan.
Tanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hilchot hekdesh, terumot umaasrot — hen hen gufe tora,
b: Venimseru leamme haaretz.

Tanya rabbi natan omer: baavon nedarim meta ishsha shel adam, shenneemar: "im en lecha leshallem lamma yikkach mishkavcha mittachtecha". rabbi omer: baavon nedarim banim metim keshehen ketannim, shenneemar: "al titten et picha lachati et besarecha veal tomar lifne hammalach ki shegaga hi lamma yiktzof haelohim al kolecha vechibbel et maase yadecha". eze hen maase yadav shel adam? heve omer banav uvenotav shel adam.

Tanu rabbanan: baavon nedarim banim metim, divre rabbi elazar berabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda hannasi omer: baavon bittul tora. bishlama leman deamar baavon nedarim — kedaamaran, ella leman deamar baavon bittul tora may keraa? dichtiv: "lashshav hikketi et benechem musar lo lakachu". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: leman deamar baavon nedarim name mehacha: "lashshav hikketi et benechem" — al iske shav. mikkede rabbi yehuda hannasi hayeynu rabbi, verabbi baavon nedarim kaamar?! batar deshama merabbi elazar berabbi shimon.

Peligi ba rabbi chiyyay bar abba verabbi yose, chad amar baavon mezuza. vechad amar baavon bittul tora. leman deamar baavon mezuza, mikra nidrash lefanav velo lifne fanav. uleman deamar baavon bittul tora, mikra nidrash lefanav velifne fanav.

Peligi ba rabbi meir verabbi yehuda. chad amar baavon mezuza, vechad amar baavon tzitzit. bishlama leman deamar baavon mezuza, dichtiv: "uchetavtam al mezuzot betecha", uchetiv batreh: "lemaan yirbu yemechem vime venechem". ella leman deamar baavon tzitzit may tama? amar rav kahana, veittema shela mari, dichtiv: "gam bichnafayich nimtzeu dam nafshot evyonim nekiyyim". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: leman deamar baavon mezuza name mehacha, dichtiv: "lo bammachteret metzatim" — sheasu petachim kemachteret.

Amar resh lakish: kol hazzahir betzitzit zoche umeshammeshin lo shene alafim ushemone meot avadim. shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai [tzevaot] bayyamim hahemma asher yachaziku asara anashim mikkol leshonot haggoyim [vehecheziku] bichnaf ish yehudi lemor nelcha immachem vegomer".

Siman: seno challa teruma nigzelet dina shevua shippucheta gilluya venivluta. tanya, rabbi nechemya omer: baavon sinat chinnam meriva rava betoch beto shel adam, veishto mappelet nefalim, uvanav uvenotav shel adam metim keshehen ketannim. rabbi elazar berabbi yehuda omer: baavon challa en beracha bamchunnas, umeera mishtallachat bashshearim, vezorin zeraim vaacherim ochlin, shenneemar: "af ani eese zot lachem vehifkadti alechem behala et hashshachefet veet hakkaddachat mechallot enayim umedivot nafesh uzeratem larik zarachem vaachaluhu oyvechem". al tikre "behala" ella "bachalla". veim notnin — mitbarchin, shenneemar: "[v]reshit arisotechem tittenu lakkohen lehaniach beracha el betecha".

Baavon bittul terumot umaasrot shamayim neetzarin millehorid tal umatar, vehayyoker hove, vehassachar aved, uvene adam ratzin achar parnasatan veen maggiin, shenneemar: "tziyya gam chom yigzelu meme sheleg sheol chatau". may mashma? tana deve rabbi yishmael: bishvil devarim shetztzivviti etchem bimot hachamma velo asitem, yiggazlu mikkem meme sheleg bimot haggeshamim. veim notnin — mitbarchin, shenneemar: "haviu et kol hammaaser el bet haotzar vihi teref beveti uvechanuni na bazot amar Adonai tzevaot im lo eftach lachem et arubbot hashshamayim vaharikoti lachem beracha ad beli day". may "ad beli day"? amar rame bar (rav) [chama] amar rav: ad sheyyivlu siftotechem millomar "day".

Baavon gezel haggovay ole, veharaav hove, uvene adam ochlim besar benehen uvenotehen, shenneemar: "shimu haddavar hazze parot habbashan asher behar shomron haoshkot dallim harotztzot evyonim". amar rava: kegon hane neshe demachoza

a: Deochlan vela avdan. uchetiv: "hikketi etchem bashshiddafon uvayyerakon harebot gannotechem vecharmechem uteenechem vezetechem yochal haggazam", uchetiv: "yeter haggazam achal haarbe veyeter haarbe achal hayyalek veyeter hayyelek achal hechasil". uchetiv: "vayyigzor al yamin veraev vayyochal al semol velo saveu ish besar zeroo yochelu", al tikre "besar zeroo" ella "besar zaro".

Baavon innuy haddin, veiuut haddin, vekilkul haddin, uvittul tora — cherev uvizza rava, vedever uvatztzoret ba, uvene adam ochlin veenan sevein, veochlin lachmam bemishkal. dichtiv: "veheveti alechem cherev nokemet nekam berit vegomer". veen "berit" ella tora, shenneemar: "im lo veriti yomam valayla vegomer", uchetiv: "beshivri lachem matte lechem veafu eser nashim vegomer", uchetiv: "yaan uveyaan bemishpatay maasu".

Baavon shevuat shav ushevuat sheker vechillul hashshem vechillul shabbat — chayya raa rava, uvehema kala, uvene adam mitmaatin, vehadderachim mishtommin. shenneemar: "veim beelle lo tivvasru li" — al tikre "beelle", ella "beala". uchetiv: "vehishlachti vachem et chayyat hassade vegomer", uchetiv bishvuat sheker: "velo tishshavu vishmi lashshaker vechillalta et shem elohecha", uvechillul hashshem ketiv: "velo techallelu et shem kodshi". uvechillul shabbat ketiv: "mechalleleha mot yumat", veyalef "chillul" "chillul" mishshevuat sheker.

Baavon shefichut damim bet hammikdash charev, ushechina mistalleket miyyisrael, shenneemar: "velo tachanifu vegomer velo tetamme et haaretz asher attem yoshvim bah asher ani shochen betochah". ha attem metammeim otah — enchem yoshvim bah, veeni shochen betochah.

Baavon gilluy arayot vaavoda zara vehashematat shemittin veyovlot — galut ba laolam, umaglin otan, uvain acherim veyoshvin bimkoman. shenneemar: "ki et kol hattoevot hael asu anshe haaretz vegomer", uchetiv: "vattitma haaretz vaefkod avonah aleha vegomer", uchetiv: "velo taki haaretz etchem betammaachem otah".
Uvaavoda zara ketiv: "venatatti et pigrechem vegomer", uchetiv: "vahashimmoti et mikdeshechem vegomer", "veetchem ezare vaggoyim".
Bishmittin uveyovlot ketiv: "az tirtze haaretz et shabbetoteha kol yeme hoshamma veattem beeretz oyvechem vegomer", uchetiv: "kol yeme hoshshamma tishbot".

Baavon navlut pe tzarot rabbot, ugezerot kashot mitchaddeshot, uvachure sone yisrael metim, yetomim vealmanot tzoakin veenan naanin, shenneemar: "al ken al bachurav lo yismach Adonai veet yetomav (vealmenotav) [veet almenotav] lo yerachem ki chullo chanef umera vechol pe dover nevala bechol zot lo shav appo veod yado netuya".

May "veod yado netuya" — amar rabbi chanan bar rava: hakkol yodin kalla lamma nichnesa lachuppa. ella kol hamenabbel piv afillu chotmin alav gezar din shel shivim shana letova — hofchin alav leraa. amar rabba bar shela amar rav chisda: kol hamenabbel et piv — maamikin lo gehinnam, shenneemar: "shucha amukka pi zarot". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: af shomea veshotek, shenneemar: "zeum Adonai yippol sham".

Amar rav oshaya: kol hammemarek atzmo laavera — chabburot ufetzain yotzin bo, shenneemar: "chabburot petza tamruk bera". velo od ella shenniddon behidrokan: shenneemar "umakkot chadre vaten". amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: siman laavera hidrokan.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha mine hidrokan hen: shel avera ave, veshel raav tafuach, veshel keshafim dak.

Shemuel hakkatan chash beh. amar: ribbono shel olam, mi mefis? ittassi. abbaye chash beh. amar rava: yadana beh benachamani demachpen nafsheh. rava chash beh. veha rava hu deamar nefishi ketile kedar minnefiche chafan? shane rava, deonsi leh rabbanan beiddaneh beal kurecheh.
Tanu rabbanan: arbaa simanin hen: siman laavera — hidrokan, siman lesinat chinnam — yerakon, siman legassut haruach — aniyyut, siman lelashon hara — askara.
Tanu rabbanan: askara baa leolam
b: Al hammaaser. rabbi elazar berabbi yose omer: al lashon hara. amar rava veittema rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may keraa — "vehammelech yismach belohim yithallel kol hannishba bo ki yissacher pi dovre shaker".

Ibbaya lehu: rabbi elazar berabbi yose al lashon hara kaamar, o dilma af al lashon hara name kaamar? ta shema: keshennichnesu rabbotenu lakkerem beyavne haya sham rabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi yose verabbi shimon nishala sheela zo bifnehem: makka zo, mippene ma matchelet bivne meayim vegomeret bappe? naana rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay "rosh hamedabberim bechol makom" veamar: af al pi shekkelayot yoatzot, velev mevin, velashon mechattech — pe gomer. naana rabbi elazar berabbi yose veamar: mippene sheochlin bah devarim temein. devarim temeim salka datach? ella sheochlin bah devarim sheenan metukkanim. naana rabbi shimon veamar: baavon bittul tora.
Amru lo: nashim yochichu! — shemmevattelot et baalehen. goyim yochichu! — shemmevattelin et yisrael. tinokot yochichu! — shemmevattelin et avihen. tinokot shel bet rabban yochichu!

Hatam kidrabbi gureyon, deamar rabbi gureyon veittema rav yosef berabbi shemaya: bizman shehatztzaddikim baddor — tzaddikim nitpasim al haddor, en tzaddikim baddor — tinokot shel bet rabban nitpasim al haddor. amar rabbi yitzchak bar zeeri, veamri la amar rabbi shimon ben nezira: may keraa — "im lo tedi lach hayyafa bannashim tzei lach beikve hatztzon vegomer", veamrinan: gedayim hamemushekanin al haroim. shema minna: af al lashon hara name kaamar — shema minna.
