Veammay karu leh "rosh hamedabberim bechol makom"? deyatvi rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon, veyatev yehuda ben gerim gabbayyhu. patach rabbi yehuda veamar: kamma naim maasehen shel umma zo: tikkenu shevavkim, tikkenu gesharim, tiknu merchatzaot. rabbi yose shatak. naana rabbi shimon ben yochay veamar: kol ma shettikkenu, lo tikkenu ella letzorech atzman. tikkenu shevavkin — lehoshiv bahen zonot, merchatzaot — leadden bahen atzman, gesharim — littol mehen meches. halach yehuda ben gerim vesipper divrehem, venishmeu lammalchut. amru: yehuda sheilla — yitalle. yose sheshshatak — yigle letzippori. shimon shegginna — yehareg.

Azal hu uvereh, tesho be midresha. kol yoma hava matya lehu devethu rifta vechuza demayya vecharchi. ki tekef gezerta amar leh livreh: nashim datan kalla alehen, dilma metzaari la umegalleya lan. azalu tesho bimarta. itrechish nissa ibberi lehu charuva veena demayya, vahavo mashlechi manayyhu vahavo yatvi ad tzavverayyhu bechala. kulle yoma garsi. beiddan tzalloye lavshi mikkassu umetzallu, vahadar mashlechi manayyhu ki hechi dela livlu. ittivu teresar shene bimarta. ata eliyyahu vekam appitcha dimarta, amar: man lodeh levar yochay demit kesar uvetil gezerteh.

Nefaku, chazo inashe deka karvi vezari, amrin: mannichin chayye olam veoskin bechayye shaa. kol makom shennotnin enehen miyyad nisraf. yatzta bat kol veamra lahem: lehachariv olami yetzatem?! chizru limaratchem! hadur azul ittivu teresar yarche shatta. amri: mishpat reshaim begehinnam shenem asar chodesh. yatzta bat kol veamra: tzeu mimmearatchem! nefaku. kol hecha dahava mache rabbi elazar, hava masse rabbi shimon. amar lo: beni, day laolam ani veatta.

Bahade panya demaale shabbeta chazo hahu sava dahava naket tere maddane asa verahet ben hashshemashot. amaru leh: hane lema lach? amar lehu: lichvod shabbat. vetisge lach bechad! — chad keneged "zachor" vechad keneged "shamor". amar leh livreh: chazi kamma chavivin mitzvot al yisrael. iyyetiva datayyhu.

Shema rabbi pinchas ben yair chatneh unefak leappeh. ayyeyleh leve vane, hava ka arech leh levisreh. chaza dahava beh pile begufeh. hava ka vache veka natran dimat eneh vekamtzavvecha leh. amar lo: oy li sheriticha bechach. amar lo: ashrecha sheritani bechach, sheilmale lo reitani bechach — lo matzata bi kach. demeikkara ki hava makshe rabbi shimon ben yochay kusheya, hava mefarek leh rabbi pinchas ben yair teresar peruke. lesof, ki hava makshe rabbi pinchas ben yair kusheya — hava mefarek leh rabbi shimon ben yochay esrin vearbea peruke.

Amar: hoil veitrechish nissa ezil atken milleta. dichtiv: "vayyavo yaakov shalem", veamar rav: shalem begufo, shalem bemamono, shalem betorato. "vayyichan et pene hair", amar rav: matbea tikken lahem, ushemuel amar: shevavkim tikken lahem, verabbi yochanan amar: merchatzaot tikken lahem. amar: ikka milleta devae letakkone? amaru leh: ikka ducheta deit beh sefek tumea

a: Veit lehu tzaara lechohanim leakkofe. amar: ikka inish deyada deittachzak hacha tohora? amar leh hahu sava: kan kitztzetz ben zakkay turemse teruma. avad ihu name hachi, kol hecha dahava keshe — tahareh, vechol hecha dahava refe — tzayyeyneh.

Amar hahu sava: tiher ben yochay bet hakkevarot! amar leh: ilmale lo hayita immanu, vaafillu hayita immanu, velo nimneta immanu — yafe atta omer. achshav shehayita immanu, venimneta immanu, yomru: zonot mefarkesot zo et zo, talmide chachamim lo kol shekken?! yehav beh eneh venach nafsheh. nefak leshuka chazyeh lihuda ben gerim. amar: adayin yesh leze baolam? natan bo enav veasahu gal shel atzamot.

Mishna shelosha devarim tzarich adam lomar betoch beto erev shabbat im chashecha: issartem? eravtem? — hadeliku et hanner. safek chashecha safek eno chashecha — en measserin et havvadday, veen matbilin et hakkelim, veen madlikin et hannerot. aval measserin et haddemay, umearvin, vetomnin et hachammin.

Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: amar kera: "veyadata ki shalom oholecha ufakadta navcha velo techeta". amar rabba bar rav huna: af al gav daamur rabbanan shelosha devarim tzarich adam lomar vechulei — tzerich lememrinehu benichuta, ki hechi delikabbelinhu minneh. amar rav ashe: ana la shemia li ha derabba bar rav huna, vekayyemta missevara.

Ha gufa kashya: amrat shelosha devarim tzarich adam lomar betoch beto erev shabbat im chashecha. im chashecha — in, safek chashecha safek eno chashecha — la. vahadar tane: safek chashecha safek eno chashecha — mearev.
Siman: begufeya zimra tzippera bechavla demelata.
Amar rabbi abba amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: la kashya, kan beeruve techumin, kan beeruve chatzerot.

Veamar rava: amru lo shenayim tze vearev alenu, leechad erav alav mibbeod yom, uleechad erav alav ben hashshemashot — ze sheerav alav mibbeod yom neechal eruvo ben hashshemashot, veze sheerav alav ben hashshemashot neechal eruvo mishshechashecha. shenehem kanu eruv.
Ma nafshach. i ben hashshemashot yemama hu — batra likne kamma la likne. vei ben hashshemashot lelya hu — kamma likne batra la likne! ben hashshemashot sefeka hu, usefeka derabbanan lekulla.

[Amar] rava: mippene ma amru en tomnin bedavar sheeno mosif hevel mishshechashecha? — gezera shemma yartiach. amar leh abbaye: i hachi, ben hashshemashot name nigzar?! amar leh: setam kederot rotchot hen.
Veamar rava:
b: Mippene ma amru en tomnin bedavar hammosif hevel vaafillu mibbeod yom? — gezera shemma yatmin beremetz sheyyesh bah gachelet. amar leh abbaye: veyatmin? gezera shemma yechatte baggechalim.
Tanu rabbanan: ben hashshemashot safek min hayyom umin hallayla, safek kullo min hayyom, safek kullo min hallayla — metilin oto lechomer shene yamim.

Veezehu ben hashshemashot? — mishshettishka hachamma kol zeman sheppene mizrach maadimin. hichsif hattachton velo hichsif haelyon — ben hashshemashot. hichsif haelyon vehishva lattachton — zehu layla, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi nechemya omer: kede sheyyehallech adam mishshettishka hachamma chatzi mil. rabbi yosi omer: ben hashshemashot keheref ayin, ze nichnas veze yotze, vei efshar laamod alav.

Amar mar: metilin oto lechomer shene yamim. lemay hilcheta? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua leinyan tumea, keditnan: raa shene yamim ben hashshemashot — safek lattumea velakkorban. raa yom echad ben hashshemashot — safek lattumea.

Ha gufa kashya. amrat ezehu ben hashshemashot — mishshettishka hachamma, kol zeman sheppene mizrach maadimin. ha hichsif hattachton velo hichsif haelyon — layla hu. vahadar tane: hichsif hattachton velo hichsif haelyon — ben hashshemashot. amar rabba amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: keroch uteni: ezehu ben hashshemashot — mishshettishka hachamma kol zeman sheppene mizrach maadimin. vehichsif hattachton velo hichsif haelyon — name ben hashshemashot. hichsif haelyon vehishva lattachton — layla. verav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, hachi katane: mishshettishka hachamma kol zeman sheppene mizrach maadimin — yom. hichsif hattachton velo hichsif haelyon — ben hashshemashot. hichsif haelyon vehishva lattachton — layla.

Veazdu letamayyhu, deittemar: shiur ben hashshemashot bechamma? amar rabba amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shelosha chelke mil. may shelosha chelke mil? ilema telata palge mila — nema mil umechetza. ella telata tilte mila — nema mil. ella: telata rive mila. verav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shene chelke mil. may shene chelke mil? ilema tere palge mila — lema mil. veella tere rive mila — lema chatzi mil. ella

a: Tere tilte mil. may benayyhu? — ikka benayyhu palga dedanka.
Vechillufa bechalleta. deamar rabba: challeta bat tere chore — shere letaltola, uvat telata chore — asir letaltola. verav yosef amar: bat telata chore — name shere, bat arbea chore — asir.

Amar abbaye: beay minneh demar bishat maase, vaafillu bat tere chore la shera li. keman — kehay tanna ditnan: kavvevret hakkash vechavvevret hakkanim uvor sefina alekkesanderit, af al pi sheyyesh lahem shulayim vehen machazikot arbaim sea ballach shehen korayim bayyavesh — tehorim. amar abbaye: shema minna hay gudesha tilleta have.

Abbaye chazyeh lerava deka dave lemaarav. amar leh: vehatanya kol zeman sheppene mizrach maadimin? amar leh: mi savrat pene mizrach mammash? la, panim hammaadimin et hammizrach. ikka deamri: rava chazyeh leabbaye deka dave lemizrach. amar leh mi savrat pene mizrach mammash? panim hammaadimin et hammizrach. vesimanaych: kavvevta.

Rabbi nechemya omer kede sheyyehallech adam mishshettishka hachamma chatzi mil. amar rabbi chanina: harotze leda shiuro shel rabbi nechemya yanniach chamma berosh hakkarmel veyered veyitbol bayyam veyaale — vezehu shiuro shel rabbi nechemya.

Amar rabbi chiyyay: harotze lirot beerah shel miryam yaale lerosh hakkarmel veyitzpe veyire kemin kevara bayyam — vezo hi beerah shel miryam. amar rav: mayan hammittaltel tahor — vezehu beerah shel miryam.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: ben hashshemashot derabbi yehuda, kohanim tovlin bo. leman? ilema lerabbi yehuda — sefeka hu. ella, ben hashshemashot derabbi yehuda, lerabbi yose kohanim tovlin bo.
Peshita! mahu detema: ben hashshemashot derabbi yose meshach shayech bidrabbi yehuda — ka mashma lan deshalem ben hashshemashot derabbi yehuda, vahadar matchel ben hashshemashot derabbi yose.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yehuda leinyan shabbat, vahalacha kerabbi yose leinyan teruma. bishlama halacha kerabbi yehuda leinyan shabbat — lechumera. aval leinyan teruma — may hi? ilema litvila — sefeka hi?
b: Ella laachilat teruma, dela achli kohanim teruma ad deshalem ben hashshemashot derabbi yose.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kochav echad — yom, shenayim — ben hashshemashot, shelosha — layla. tanya name hachi: kochav echad yom, shenayim ben hashshemashot, shelosha layla. amar rabbi yose, lo kochavim gedolim hannirin bayyom, velo kochavim ketannim sheen nirin ella ballayla — ella benonim.

Amar rabbi yose berabbi zevida: haose melacha bishne ben hashshemashot — chayyayv chattat mimma nafshach. amar leh rava leshammaeh: attun dela kim lechu beshiura derabbanan, addeshimsha ares dikle atlo sheraga. beyom hameunnan may? bemata — chazi tarnegola. bedavra — orve, i name — adane.

Tanu rabbanan: shesh tekiot tokin erev shabbat. rishona — lehavetil et haam mimmelacha shebbassadot. sheniyya — lehavetil ir vachanuyot. shelishit — lehadelik et hanner, divre rabbi natan. rabbi yehuda hannasi omer: shelishit — lachalotz tefillin. veshohe kede tzeliyyayt dag katan o kede lehadebik pat battannur, vetokea umeria vetokea, veshovet.

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: ma naase lahem labbavliyyim, shettokin umeriin veshovtin mittoch meriin. tokin umeriin? havu lehu chamishsha! ella: shettokin vechozrin vetokin umeriin, veshovtin mittoch meriin. minhag avotehen bidehen.
Matne leh rav yehuda lerav yitzchak bereh: sheniyya lehadelik et hanner. keman? la kerabbi natan, vela kerabbi yehuda hannasi! — ella: shelishit lehadelik et hanner. keman — kerabbi natan.

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: shesh tekiot tokin erev shabbat. hitchil litkoa tekia rishona — nimneu haomdim bassade millaador umillachrosh umillaasot kol melacha shebbassadot. veen hakkerovin rashshain likkanes ad sheyyavou rechokin, veyikkansu kullam keechad. vaadayin chanuyot petuchot uterisin munnachin. hitchil litkoa tekia sheniyya, nistalleku hatterisin veninalu hachanuyot, vaadayin chammin munnachin al gabbe kira ukederot munnachot al gabbe kira. hitchil litkoa tekia shelishit — sillek hamesallek, vehitmin hammatmin, vehidlik hammadlik. veshohe kede tzeliyyayt dag katan, o kede lehadebik pat battannur, vetokea umeria vetokea veshovet.

Amar rabbi yose bar chanina: shamati sheim ba lehadelik achar shesh tekiot — madlik. shehare natnu chachamim shiur lechazzan hakkeneset leholich shofaro leveto. amru lo, im ken natatta devarecha leshiurin. ella makom tzanua yesh lo lechazzan hakkeneset berosh gaggo, sheshsham manniach shofaro. lefi sheen metaltelin lo et hashshofar velo et hachatzotzrot.
Vehatanya: shofar mittaltel vachatzotzrot enam mittaltelin! amar rav (yose) [yosef], la kashya: kan beyachid, kan betzibbur. amar leh abbaye: uveyachid lemay chaze? — hoil verauy legammea bo mayim.

a: Letinok. betzibbur name, chaze legammea letinok ani? vetu, ha detanya: keshem shemmetaltelin et hashshofar kach metaltelin et hachatzotzrot. manni? ella la kashya: ha rabbi yehuda, ha rabbi shimon, ha rabbi nechemya.

Umay shofar — name chatzotzrot. kidrav chisda. deamar rav chisda: hane telat mille ishtanni shemayyhu mikki charav bet hammikdash: "chatzotzarta" — "shofara", "shofara" — "chatzotzarta". lemay nafka minna? leshofar shel rosh hashshana.
"Arava" — "tzaftzafa", "tzaftzafa" — "arava". lemay nafka minna? lelulav.
"Patura" — "patureta", "patureta" — "patura". lemay nafka minna? lemikkach umimkar.
Amar abbaye, af anu nomar: "huvelila" — "be chase", "be chase" — "huvelila". lemay nafka minna — lemachat shennimtzet beovi bet hakkosot, demitztzad echad keshera, umishshene tzedadim terefa.
Amar rav ashe, af anu nomar: "bavel" — "borsif", "borsif" — "bavel".
b: Lemay nafka minna — legitte nashim.
Haderan alach bema madlikin

Mishna kira shehissikuha bekash uvigvava — notnim aleha tavshil. begefet uveetzim — lo yitten ad sheyyigrof, o ad sheyyitten et haefer. bet shammay omrim: chammin, aval lo tavshil. uvet hillel omrim: chammin vetavshil. bet shammay omrim: notlin, aval lo machazirin. uvet hillel omrim: af machazirin.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: hay "lo yitten" — lo yachazir hu, aval leshahot — meshahin, af al pi sheeno garuf veeno katum. umanni — chananya hi. detanya, chananya omer: kol shehu kemaachol ben derusay — muttar leshahoto al gabbe kira, af al pi sheeno garuf veeno katum. o dilma — leshahot tenan, vei garuf vekatum — en, i la — la, vechol shekken lehachazir.

Ta shema middekatane tere vave bematnitin, bet shammay omrim: chammin aval lo tavshil. uvet hillel omrim chammin vetavshil. bet shammay omrim: notlin aval lo machazirin, uvet hillel omrim: af machazirin. i amrat bishlama, leshahot tenan, hachi katane: kira shehissikuha bekash uvigvava — meshahin aleha tavshil, begefet uveetzim — lo yeshahe ad sheyyigrof, o ad sheyyitten efer. uma hen meshahin? — bet shammay omrim: chammin, aval lo tavshil. uvet hillel omrim: chammin vetavshil. vechi hechi difligi bilshahot, peligi name bilhachazir, shebbet shammay omrim: notlin, aval lo machazirin, uvet hillel omrim: af machazirin.

Ella i amrat lehachazir tenan, hachi katane: kira shehissikuha bekash uvigvava — machazirin aleha tavshil. begefet uveetzim — lo yachazir ad sheyyigrof o ad sheyyitten efer. uma hen machazirin? — bet shammay omrim: chammin, aval lo tavshil. uvet hillel omrim: chammin vetavshil. bet shammay omrim: notlin aval lo machazirin. uvet hillel omrim: af machazirin. ha tu lema li?

a: Leolam ema lach lehachazir tenan, vechassore michassera vehachi katane: kira shehissikuha bekash uvigvava — machazirin aleha tavshil, begefet uveetzim — lo yachazir ad sheyyigrof o ad sheyyitten et haefer. aval leshahot — meshahin af al pi sheeno garuf veeno katum. uma hen meshahin? — bet shammay omrim: chammin, aval lo tavshil. uvet hillel omrim: chammin vetavshil. vehach chazara daamari lach, lav divre hakkol hi, ella machaloket bet shammay uvet hillel, shebbet shammay omrim: notlin velo machazirin. uvet hillel omrim: af machazirin.

Ta shema, deamar rabbi chelbo amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: lo shanu ella al gabbah, aval letochah — asur. i amrat bishlama "lehachazir" tenan — hayeynu deshane ben tochah leal gabbah. ella i amrat "leshahot" tenan, ma li tochah ma li al gabbah? — mi savrat rabbi chelbo aresha kae? assefa kae: "uvet hillel omrim af machazirin" — veamar rabbi chelbo amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: lo shanu ella al gabbah, aval tochah — asur.

Ta shema: shete kirot hammatimot, achat gerufa uketuma, veachat sheenah gerufa veenah ketuma: meshahin al gabbe gerufa uketuma veen meshahin al sheenah gerufa veenah ketuma. uma hen meshahin? — bet shammay omrim: velo chelum. uvet hillel omrim: chammin, aval lo tavshil. akar — divre hakkol lo yachazir, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer — bet shammay omrim: chammin, aval lo tavshil. uvet hillel omrim: chammin vetavshil. bet shammay omrim: notlin, aval lo machazirin. uvet hillel omrim: af machazirin.

I amrat bishlama "leshahot" tenan, matnitin manni — rabbi yehuda hi. ella i amrat "lehachazir" tenan, matnitin manni? la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi meir. i rabbi meir — kashya levet shammay bachada, ulevet hillel betarte. i rabbi yehuda, kashya gerufa uketuma.

Leolam ema lach "lehachazir" tenan, vetanna didan savar la kerabbi yehuda bachada ufelig aleh bachada. savar la kerabbi yehuda bachada — bechammin vetavshil, venotlin umachzirin. ufelig aleh bachada — deillu tanna didan savar leshahot veaf al pi sheeno garuf vekatum, verabbi yehuda savar bilshahot name garuf vekatum — in, i la — la.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu lismoch bah? tochah vegabbah asur, aval lismoch bah — shappir dame, o dilma la shena.

Ta shema: shete kirot hammatimot, achat gerufa uketuma veachat sheenah gerufa uketuma, meshahin al gabbe gerufa uketuma. veaf al gav deka salek leh havela meidach! dilma shane hatam, dechevan demiddalleya shalet bah avvera.

Ta shema, deamar rav safra amar rav chiyyay: ketamah venitlabbeta, somchin lah umekayyeymin aleha, venotlin mimmenna umachzirin lah. shema minna lismoch name, ketamah — in, lo ketamah — la. uletamaych, "notlin mimmenna" dekatane, ketamah — in, lo ketamah — la?! ella tena notlin mishshum machzirin, hacha name tena somchin mishshum mekayyeymin.
Hachi hasheta?! hatam notlin umachzirin bechad makom hu, tena notlin mishshum machzirin. ella hacha — somchin bechad makom hu umekayyeymin bechad makom hu.
May have ala? ta shema: kira shehissikuha begefet uveetzim somchin lah, veen mekayyeymin ella im ken gerufa uketuma. gechalim sheammu o shennatan aleha neoret shel pishtan dakka — hare hi kiktuma.
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani amar rav oshaya: ketamah vehuveara meshahin aleha chammin shehuchammu kol tzorkan vetavshil shebbishshel kol tzorko.
b: Shema minna mitztammek veyafe lo muttar! shane hacha dekatma. i hachi may lememra?! huveara itztericha leh, mahu detema kevan dehuveara hadra lah lemilleta kammayyta, kamashma lan.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: ketamah vehuveara, meshahin aleha chammin shehuchammu kol tzorkan vetavshil shebbishshel kol tzorko, vaafillu gechalim shel rotem. shema minna mitztammek veyafe lo muttar! — shane hacha dekatma. i hachi may lememra?! huveara itztericha leh. hayeynu hach! — gechalim shel rotem itztericha leh.

Amar rav sheshet amar rabbi yochanan: kira shehissikuha begefet uveetzim meshahin aleha chammin shello huchammu kol tzorkan vetavshil shello bishshel kol tzorko. akar — lo yachazir ad sheyyigrof o ad sheyyitten efer. kasavar: matnitin "lehachazir" tenan, aval leshahot — meshahin af al pi sheeno garuf veeno katum.

Amar rava: tarvavyyhu tenanhi. leshahot tenena: en notnin et happat betoch hattannur im chashecha velo charara al gabbe gechalim ella kede sheyyikremu paneha. ha karmu paneha — shere. lehachazir name tenena: bet hillel omrim af machzirin. vead kan la kasharu bet hillel ella bigrufa uketuma, aval besheenah gerufa uketuma la! verav sheshet name diyyuka dematnitin kamashma lan.

Amar rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi yochanan: kira shehissikuha begefet uveetzim meshahin aleha tavshil shebbishshel kol tzorko vechammin shehuchammu kol tzorkan vaafillu mitztammek veyafe lo. amar leh hahu midderabbanan lerav shemuel bar yehuda: ha rav ushemuel deamri tarvavyyhu mitztammek veyafe lo asur!

Amar leh: attu let ana yada deamar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mitztammek veyafe lo — asur? ki kaamena lach, lerabbi yochanan kaamena. amar leh rav ukeva mimmeshan lerav ashe: attun dimkarvitu lerav ushemuel — avidu kerav ushemuel, anan naaved kerabbi yochanan.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: mahu leshahot? amar leh: ha rav yehuda meshahu leh veachel. amar leh: bar minneh derav yehuda, dechevan dimsukkan hu — afillu beshabbat name shere lemebad leh. li velach may? amar leh: besura meshahu, deha rav nachman bar yitzchak mare deovada hava, umeshahu leh veachel. amar rav ashe: kaemna kammeh derav huna veshahin leh kasa deharsana vaachal, vela yadana i mishshum dekasavar mitztammek veyafe lo muttar, i mishshum dechevan deit beh micha — mitztammek vera lo hu.

Amar rav nachman: mitztammek veyafe lo — asur, mitztammek vera lo — muttar. kelala demilleta: kol deit beh mecha — mitztammek vera lo, levar mittavshil delifta deaf al gav deit beh mecha — mitztammek veyafe lo hu. vehane mille deit beh bisra, aval let beh bisra — mitztammek vera lo hu. vechi it beh bisra name la amaran ella dela kavae le leorchin, aval kavae le leorchin — mitztammek vera lo. lafda dayysa vetamre mitztammek vera lahen.
Beo minneh merabbi chiyyay bar abba:

a: Shachach kedera al gabbe kira uvishshelah beshabbat, mahu? ishtik vela amar leh vela midde. limchar nefak derash lehu: hamevashshel beshabbat, beshogeg — yochal, bemezid — lo yochal, vela shena.

May "vela shena"? rabba verav yosef deamri tarvavyyhu lehettera: mevashshel hu deka aved maase bemezid — lo yochal, aval hay dela ka aved maase — bemezid name yochal. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar leissura: mevashshel hu dela ate leiarome, beshogeg yochal, aval hay deate leiarome — beshogeg name la yochal.

Metivi: shachach kedera al gabbe kira uvishshela beshabbat, beshogeg — yochal, bemezid — lo yochal. bamme devarim amurim — bechammin shello huchammu kol tzorkan vetavshil shello bishshel kol tzorko, aval chammin shehuchammu kol tzorkan vetavshil shebbishshel kol tzorko, ben beshogeg ben bemezid — yochal, divre rabbi meir.

Rabbi yehuda omer: chammin shehuchammu kol tzorkan — muttarin mippene shemmitztammek vera lo. vetavshil shebbishshel kol tzorko — asur mippene shemmitztammek veyafe lo, vechol hammitztammek veyafe lo, kegon keruv ufolim uvasar taruf — asur, vechol hammitztammek vera lo — muttar.

Katane miha tavshil shello bishshel kol tzorko. bishlama larav nachman bar yitzchak la kashya: kan kodem gezera, kan leachar gezera. ella rabba verav yosef deamri lehettera, i kodem gezera — kashya mezid. i leachar gezera — kashya name shogeg. kashya.

May gezerta? deamar rav yehuda bar shemuel amar rabbi abba amar rav kahana amar rav: battechilla hayu omrim hamevashshel beshabbat, beshogeg — yochal, bemezid — lo yochal, vehu haddin lashshocheach. mishsherabbu meshahin bemezid veomrim "shechechim anu", chazru vekansu al hashshocheach.

Kashya derabbi meir adderabbi meir, kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda! derabbi meir adderabbi meir la kashya: ha lechattechilla, ha diavad. derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda name la kashya: kan — bigrufa uketuma, kan — besheenah gerufa uketuma.

Ibbaya lehu: avar veshiha may? mi kansu rabbanan, o la? ta shema, deamar shemuel bar natan amar rabbi chanina: keshehalach rabbi yose letzippori matza chammin shennishtahu al gabbe kira velo asar lahen, betzim metzummakot shennishtahu al gabbe kira, veasar lahen. may lav leoto shabbat? — la, leshabbat habbaa.

Mikkelal devetzim metzummakot — mitztammekot veyafe lahen ninhu? in. deamar rav chama bar chanina: paam achat nitarachti ani verabbi limkom echad veheviu lefanenu betzim metzummakot keuzeradin veachalnu mehen harebe.
Bet hillel omrim: af machzirin. amar rav sheshet: ledivre haomer
b: Machzirin, afillu beshabbat. veaf rabbi oshaya savar "af machzirin" — afillu beshabbat. deamar rabbi oshaya: paam achat hayeynu omdim leella merabbi chiyyay rabba vehaalenu lo kumekmos shel chammin middeyota hattachtona lidyota haelyona, umazagnu lo et hakkos, vehechezarnuhu limkomo, velo amar lanu davar.

Amar rabbi zerika amar rabbi abba amar rabbi tadday: lo shanu ella sheodan beyado, aval hinnichan al gabbe karka — asur. amar rabbi amme: rabbi tadday daavad — legarmeh hu daavad. ella hachi amar rabbi chiyyay amar rabbi yochanan: afillu hannicha al gabbe karka — muttar.

Peligi ba rav dimi verav shemuel bar yehuda, vetarvayyhu mishshemeh derabbi elazar amri. chad amar: odan beyado — muttar, al gabbe karka — asur. vechad amar: hinnichan al gabbe karka name muttar. amar chizkiyya mishshemeh deabbaye: ha deamrat odan beyado — muttar, la amaran ella sheddato lehachazir, aval en dato lehachazir — asur. mikkelal deal gabbe karka af al pi sheddato lehachazir — asur.

Ikka deamri, amar chizkiyya mishshemeh deabbaye: ha deamrat al gabbe karka — asur, la amaran ella sheen dato lehachazir, aval dato lehachazir — muttar. mikkelal shebbeodan beyado, af al pi sheen dato lehachazir — muttar. bae rabbi yirmeya: telaan bemakkel mahu? hinnichan al gabbe matta mahu? bae rav ashe: pinnan mimmecham limyachem mahu? — teku.
Mishna tannur shehissikuhu bekash uvigvava lo yitten ben mittocho ben meal gabbav. kuppach shehissikuhu bekash uvigvava — hare ze kechirayim, begefet uveetzim — hare hu ketannur.

Gemara tannur shehissikuhu: savar rav yosef lememar "tocho" — tocho mammash, "al gabbav" — al gabbav mammash, aval lismoch shappir dame. etiveh abbaye: kuppach shehissikuhu bekash uvigvava hare hu kechirayim, begefet uveetzim hare hu ketannur, veasur. ha kechira — shere. bemay askinan? ilema al gabbav, uvemay? ilema kesheeno garuf vekatum, ella kira ki enah gerufa uketuma, al gabbav mi shere? ella lav lismoch, vekatane: hare hu ketannur, vaasir!

Amar rav adda bar ahava: hacha bechuppach garuf vekatum, vetannur gerufa uketuma askinan. hare hu ketannur — deaf al gav degaruf vekatum — al gabbav asur, dei kechira ki gerufa uketuma — shappir dame. tanya kevoteh deabbaye: tannur shehissikuhu bekash uvigvava en somchin lo, veen tzarich lomar al gabbav, veen tzarich lomar letocho, veen tzarich lomar begefet uveatzim. kuppach shehissikuhu bekash uvigvava somchin lo, veen notnin al gabbav. begefet uveetzim en somchin lo.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: hay kuppach hechi dame? i kechira dame, afillu begefet uveetzim name! i ketannur dame, afillu bekash uvigvava name la! amar leh: nefish haveleh middechira vezutar haveleh middetannur.

Hechi dame kuppach, hechi dame kira? amar rabbi yose bar chanina: kuppach — mekom shefitat kedera achat. kira — mekom shefitat shete kederot. amar abbaye, veittema rabbi yirmeya: af anan name tenena: kira shennechleka leorka — tehora. lerochbah — temea. kuppach, ben leorko ben lerochbo — tahor.
Mishna en notnin betza betzad hammecham bishvil shettitgalgel, velo yafkienna besudarin. verabbi yose mattir. velo yatminenna bechol uvaavak derachim bishvil shettitztzale.

Maase sheasu anshe teverya veheviu silon shel tzonen letoch amma shel chammin. amru lahem chachamim: im beshabbat — kechammin shehuchammu beshabbat, vaasurin birchitza uvishtiyyah. im beyom tov — kechammin shehuchammu beyom tov, vaasurin birchitza, umuttarin bishtiyya.
